Rules change. **Doors close.** That's why we have to [**move fast**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBPbU-E7rD9HVRc4u0k2sxUugG3ueh3q3fpT4YgU1yyXr-utp8wuHnOu_HTgaAzJy51EM7Jh3lVtKmWN5a7-ItmK6OBKPelOoZ-adU8UgInvv_gCcKB9IttrIIpW3YoxoKAyW4NjnA_pI_XjFEsGOTCplMGKocVNc5-C2bfScUSG3BWrbVypYO-qdJ6AW91Mk0tk12XeUDuLYUmwKtOrl7IWQl8KH6WK4rUk3dDtS6BzCX2JttDi6SRAopKmp1tpFto/4sf/_Rj7Sz47RjuBHs875nvSxA/h3/h001.0cRMyRmb7onYCWn5vqpvtDxdmK9qNZRoNpMhhAhsSV4), and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer.I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations.
* We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots.
* We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration.
* We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal “Gain of Function” research on COVID-19.

**At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts.** Senator Paul has handed us a golden key.[**Will you help me fund this new squad?**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBPbU-E7rD9HVRc4u0k2sxUugG3ueh3q3fpT4YgU1yyXr-utp8wuHnOu_HTgaAzJy51EM7Jh3lVtKmWN5a7-ItmK6OBKPelOoZ-adU8UgInvv_gCcKB9IttrIIpW3YoxoKAyW4NjnA_pI_XjFEsGOTCplMGKocVNc5-C2bfScUSG3BWrbVypYO-qdJ6AW91Mk0seCdvanZSNpB4yT6gLWBNAvyXrn8T27FWj5rfaduuFpOP1PkoPZ0makr0D73HcKZo/4sf/_Rj7Sz47RjuBHs875nvSxA/h4/h001.cOxlZwgsZQq8bnR0AO6w1OlwTyOr7u7tNPhe1BZlmt4) Remember, Al Capone was brought down by an accountant. Friends, This Sunday, July 19th, join us and the Clarkstown Democratic Committee at the Nanuet Chamber of Commerce's Soccer Festival Block Party, where we will be collecting non-perishable food donations. If you can't make it, please consider donating to Rockland Community Against Hunger at [rocklandhunger.org/donate](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.Nfger3zIHopxMmr6fRXD1SDhZGhjS3h0-UVLPNLALPAWOWoX3xHAP4mzTcjuVZtTAr_9esXBLWDoN76-xemCxmcgzP6oa2Fq3WHH5-zsaic4Ab4g74HjKQeue6O9F_9cEuhzjltfBZhTNAectmkygOsOtrfWEUbIv08bXtMrXbyM0YzgeK7NRffG9FLoLpOkB773wj4j9aZUdHp22tNT5Id1ix1Qv40Rh-2ILEV5VrLjCcXoURPZCy8X_Ev-DQG-_py_dVeySzd6a1oEhMXeVw/4sf/PpLSigYXTVmgNispAxo9dg/h0/h001.35GJCXJBtU-I8Lb-gL95rjeJNiZ-M8rEgCeOTCBFzlI). Fellow Conservative,

> In 2016, President Trump became the first Republican to win Michigan and Wisconsin since 1988.

He created a movement. He proved the DC insiders and political pundits wrong.

And Republicans need to play defense in states like Ohio, Maine, North Carolina, and even Texas. | Fellow Conservative, In 2016, President Trump became the first Republican to win Michigan and Wisconsin since 1988. In 2024, he took Nevada for the Republican Party for the first time since George Bush in 2004. He created a movement. He proved the DC insiders and political pundits wrong. But here's the bad news : President Trump is not on the ballot this November. And Republicans need to play defense in states like Ohio, Maine, North Carolina, and even Texas. What then? Well, we'll need backup options. As a former Navy SEAL, all I know how to do is win. And with your prayers and support, I'm confident we will win this race and double the SEAL population in the Senate. Peter, every election cycle, I make it a priority to hit the campaign trail for some of our most critical Democracy Defenders, candidates in state-level races that have an outsized impact on the future of democracy. This year is no different – but the stakes are even higher. **The next phase in this existential fight against the Republican redistricting crisis is taking place at the ballot box this November.** How we fare will determine whether our country slips further into the Republican gerrymandering abyss or if we can forge a path back to a more representative democracy. **It’s why the NDRC is investing in 14 priority states where we know that, if we win, we can make a real dent in the redistricting crisis** — moving closer to ending it and ultimately stopping power grabs like this once and for all. That looks like the governors' races in Florida and Georgia. State legislative elections in Arizona and Minnesota. State supreme court seats in North Carolina and Ohio. And so many other key races in states where we can turn the tide to defend democracy. I know this to be true: The American people see the real and consequential threat that has been driven by Republicans and unleashed by an ideologically driven Supreme Court. At each juncture, when given the opportunity to make our voices heard, we the people have voted to counter Republicans’ immoral and egregious gerrymanders. **Now, we must carry the momentum into November to send a clear signal to Republicans that these un-American, anti-democracy attacks on the right to vote will be defeated. ** [**We’re putting everything we’ve got into this effort, and we need your help. # Conforti Grassroots Newsletter
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

Welcome to the Special Release of _**The Conforti Brief**_. As part of our interactive grassroots newsletter, this special edition is published on the 3rd Saturday of each month. While our main newsletters cover a wide range of campaign and policy topics, this special release is exclusively dedicated to providing you with vital current event updates.
.Our campaign is built on a "district-first" mentality. Through _The Conforti Brief_ , we are committed to prioritizing your needs by focusing on the fundamental ideals of sensible solutions and open dialogue. Thank you for staying engaged and informed as we work together for the hardworking constituents of Illinois' 6th Congressional District.
Click the button below to make a donation today. Your donations are what makes this possible.

| |
### Special Release.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| |
Demanding Real Healthcare Transparency
.A recent report by the Chicago Sun-Times sheds light on a critical issue affecting our communities: **federal hospital billing transparency laws have completely failed consumers.** Despite mandates requiring hospitals to publish their pricing in a clear, consumer-friendly format, the law has fallen short. A staggering number of hospitals remain noncompliant, often providing incomplete, confusing, or entirely missing pricing data. Furthermore, federal regulators have been incredibly slow to enforce the rules, allowing loopholes to persist while patients continue to face hidden out-of-pocket costs and surprise medical bills.
.This failure only worsens a healthcare system that has already led to unaffordable plans and widespread confusion for most Americans and small businesses. Democrats like Sean Casten have consistently failed the residents of Illinois' 6th District when it comes to healthcare affordability. Instead of fighting for his constituents and demanding accountability from large healthcare systems, Casten has been more concerned with messaging and improving his own standing. **Democrat-championed policies like Obamacare have been a disaster for Illinois** , causing healthcare costs to rise steadily over the last decade. Today, many counties only have two options for consumers, making the ironically named Affordable Care Act entirely unaffordable for most families.
.Niki Conforti plans to help the residents of the 6th District by bringing her invaluable professional experience as a former healthcare director to Congress. Once in office, **Niki will fight to make healthcare more accessible and affordable** through the following:

1. 1\. **Fostering Market Competition:** By demanding true transparency, Niki aims to drive up competition among healthcare systems, which will lower prices and drive down out-of-pocket costs for families and small business owners.
.
2. 2\. **Expanding Consumer Choice:** Niki believes that consumers should have more options in the marketplace.

Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/24rMqTOBKxV?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)
---
|
---
|
---
| | We would like to invite you to a couple upcoming events!
.
.**Meet the Candidates Night**
.We warmly invite you to join Niki Conforti and our campaign team for an exciting evening of open dialogue. This event is a fantastic opportunity to discuss our campaign's focus on grassroots engagement, economic affordability, and community safety with local leaders and neighbors. Come out to meet your candidates and share your vision for the district!

* **Date:** Wednesday, July 22, 2026
* **Time:** 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM
* **Featured Candidates:** Niki Conforti (Candidate for U.S. Congressional District 6) and Brian Skala (Candidate for IL Senate District 14)
* **Location:** Elks Lodge in Crestwood, IL

**Coffee with Niki Conforti**
.Looking for a casual setting to talk about the issues that matter most to your family? Grab a cup of coffee and join Niki for a one-on-one conversation about reining in reckless government spending, cutting red tape for small businesses, and protecting local communities.

* **Date:** Thursday, August 6, 2026
* **Time:** 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM
* **Location:** Krema Coffee in Tinley Park, IL
.
.

Get Involved: Bring your family, friends, and neighbors to these events to learn more about our District-First vision. For more information, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Meet%20the%20Candidates%2FCoffee%20with%20Niki&body=).
.We look forward to seeing you there!

Vern’s got our backs, it’s time for us to have his!

We deserve a representative who shows up, who listens to us, and who fights for us every single day. That's why I'm running.
We're building a grassroots movement focused on what actually matters to people - local issues, affordable health care, lowering costs. And this endorsement is another sign that people across the country are seeing we have what it takes to win.

The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, **the world watched, then largely moved on.** But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. **In some ways, it was only the beginning.** Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear.

I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** is to **stop the sale of God's children.** We do that through five pillars:
---
* **Prevention**
* **Intervention**
* **Education**
* **Information**
* **Influence**

---
We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to:
---
* Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster.
* Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety.
* Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free.
* Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified.
* Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet.

** _"Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked." (Psalm 82:3-4)_** That command is what guides every decision this Foundation makes. It is not a suggestion. It is not poetry. clean_body: After the earthquakes in Venezuela, traffickers are already moving. Here's how we're responding. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend, The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, the world watched, then largely moved on. But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. In some ways, it was only the beginning. Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear. We've set an urgent goal to raise $50,000 in the next 30 days to help rescue children, provide safe shelter, and reunite families before more children disappear into trafficking. Every gift brings us one step closer.Will you help us reach this lifesaving goal today? I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the Sound of Freedom Foundation is to stop the sale of God's children. We do that through five pillars: Prevention Intervention Education Information Influence We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to: Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster. Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety. Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free. Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified. Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet. "Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked." (Psalm 82:3-4) That command is what guides every decision this Foundation makes. It is not a suggestion. It is not poetry. It is an instruction, and I take it as one. We're trusting God to help us raise $50,000 in the next 30 days, but He often answers prayers through people willing to act. I hope you'll be one of them today. Friend, I am asking you urgently, humbly, and personally to make your first gift today. Please do not wait. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Right now, a displaced child in Venezuela is being watched by someone who does not have their best interest at heart. Your gift today helps make sure someone who does gets there first. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

name: GIFFORDS
subject: Holding bad actors accountable
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Team --
Gun shop owners know their responsibilities when they receive their licenses, but they are not federally required to train their employees on those responsibilities. This is not an exaggeration.
Despite being behind the counter and selling dangerous weapons, there are little to no policies in place to make sure employees are adequately trained to follow the law or gun safety best practices.
Currently, federal law states that the ATF has the power to revoke a gun dealer’s license when they’ve violated a rule or regulation. This is a key part of the ATF’s job of putting shady dealers out of business.
But now the Trump Administration has proposed that a license can only be revoked if a dealer **_knows_** that their employees violated the law. If the employees are never trained on the law...how will they know if they broke it? This loophole gives shady dealers the legal cover to look the other way.
Yet again, this administration has cooked up a regulatory scheme to appease the gun lobby and put dangerous firearms in the hands of people who shouldn’t have them.
GIFFORDS is asking for bad actors to be held accountable for the safety of our communities. There is still time to push back against this dangerous change to ATF rules.
**[We need 5,000 people to tell the ATF to keep holding gun dealers accountable for breaking the law. Will you please submit a public comment today? We’ve written a template comment below that you can submit:**](https://go.giffords.org/go/68454?t=1&akid=11644%2E3935704%2EK9zEuZ)
**[SUBMIT MY COMMENTS](https://go.giffords.org/go/68454?t=2&akid=11644%2E3935704%2EK9zEuZ)**

_I write to express my strong opposition to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives’ “Defining Willfully for Firearm Violations” notice of proposed rulemaking (RIN 1140-AA88)._
_It is important that gun shop owners and their employees know about and adhere to the laws on how to safely sell firearms to only those who should have them, with the larger goal of keeping us all safe. No small business owner should have to jump through hoops to keep their business open; however, there is a reasonable responsibility when people are selling guns that they know the laws and know how to adhere to them._
_This rule would allow shady dealers to break the law and claim it wasn’t willful, despite there being no effort to ensure the law is known and followed._
_The ATF should be working to keep Americans safe, not turning the other cheek when bad dealers break the law and allow firearms to be accessed by those who would do us harm._
_[INSERT PERSONAL REASON FOR OPPOSITION]
_Thank you,_
[SIGNATURE]_
Thank you for your support.
— GIFFORDS

Dear Fellow Republicans,
I hope you are enjoying the summer and continuing the important work of growing our Republican Party across Massachusetts.
Our Republican Town and Ward Committees are the foundation of our party, and the work happening in communities across the Commonwealth will be critical to our success this November.
First, a quick housekeeping item. We have received several questions regarding RTC membership rules, procedures, and guidelines. Please review the information below, which should provide clarity and answer many of the common questions we have received.
We also have a number of important updates from our Republican candidates across Massachusetts. Below you will find the latest news, upcoming opportunities, and ways you can help support their efforts as we continue building toward Election Day. Thank you for your continued leadership, commitment, and dedication to our party.

The following guidance should be followed regarding membership on ward and town committees under M.G.L. c. 52.

1. Elected members serve fixed four-year terms. Members elected at the presidential primary hold their seats for the term fixed by state law. Under the statute, a seat ends early only if the member moves out of the town or ward, changes or cancels their Republican enrollment, or resigns.
2. Committees may not remove or demote elected members. A committee should not vote to expel an elected member, declare an elected member's seat vacant or forfeited, or change an elected member's status to non-voting or "associate" membership.
3. Please be aware of the legal exposure. A member affected by an action of the kind described in paragraph 2 may go to court, and Massachusetts courts have the power to order a member restored, to declare the committee's action void, and to call into question votes the committee took in the meantime. Defending such an action is costly for the committee and its officers, whether or not it succeeds.
4. Organization requirements still apply. Every committee must continue to meet and organize as G.L. c. 52, § 4 requires, and to follow the State Committee's organization procedures and notices. This guidance does not change those obligations.
5. As always, ask before acting. If your committee is considering any action affecting a member's status, or has questions about its organization, contact us. We will make sure you get an answer, in coordination with counsel where needed. This email is party guidance, not a legal opinion.

name: Rep. Ilhan Omar
subject: My bill for Universal School Meals
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
This is a common-sense idea
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-jul26/?refcode=em260718-1-180&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)
Friend,
My friend Bernie Sanders and I have introduced a bill in Congress called the Universal School Meals Program Act.
The idea is simple. When we send our kids to school, they should be focused on their education, not worrying about when they will get their next meal. It’s time to remove the stigma that kids from low-income families face and provide food for all of our children in America’s public schools.
[**Please, add your name as a citizen Co-Sponsor to my bill and help me show grassroots support for this commonsense idea >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-jul26/?source=em260718-1-180&refcode2=2363.791427.VQxNVj&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-jul26/?source=em260718-1-180&refcode2=2363.791427.VQxNVj&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)**
Friend, when Minnesota passed legislation to provide free school meals in 2023, there were of course naysayers and opposition, especially from Republicans.
But three years later, this initiative has turned out to be a popular program and a smashing success. Hundreds of millions of meals have been served and countless families have felt the relief of knowing their child will get the food they need regardless of their family’s financial situation.
And years of research consistently back up the idea that access to free school meals significantly improves educational outcomes by improving attendance, concentration, and performance while reducing behavioral issues.
Now it’s time to take this idea nationwide, and ensure that every child, no matter their income, gets the nutrition they need to stay focused on their studies and thrive in any educational environment.
[**While this may be a no-brainer for most Americans, powerful corporate interests and the far-right have worked together to block my bill from being passed. Please, help us rally support for my universal school meals by signing on as a citizen Co-Sponsor of my bill with Bernie Sanders today:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-jul26/?source=em260718-1-180&refcode2=2363.791427.VQxNVj&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-school-meals-jul26/?source=em260718-1-180&refcode2=2363.791427.VQxNVj&akid=2363%2E791427%2EVQxNVj)**
Leading a successful life starts with getting a quality education, and that simply can’t happen on an empty stomach. I hope you can sign on today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

HEADLINES: Progressive Surge! | Maine Senate Update | Next Wave: Abdul
El-Sayed, Cori Bush & More | 10 Years of Our Revolution | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

OUR PROGRESSIVE PIPELINE IS DELIVERING

The political establishment is freaking out about the progressive winning
streak our candidates are having across the country — and we’re just
getting started.

Just this week, Fox News devoted airtime to attacking Our Revolution after
airing clips from our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39176?t=1011&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]National Organize-to-Win Call featuring
candidates like Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, Cori Bush, Troy Jackson, and Rep. Ro
Khanna. Their big "gotcha"? Our champions calling for
Medicare for All.

These victories and the right-wing backlash come as a result of a decade
of organizing — building the bench, getting out the vote, and growing
grassroots power from the bottom up.

At Our Revolution, we’re celebrating 10 years in the fight. We’ve helped
elect more than 1,200 progressives from city councils to Congress — this
could be our biggest election year YET.

Our Revolution has endorsed hundreds of candidates this election cycle and
we’ve made over 3.7 MILLION voter contacts so far! As Executive Director
Joseph Geevarghese told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39177?t=1012&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]Newsweek, “This isn’t a sudden surge, it’s 10
years of work becoming visible.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35232?t=1013&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]WE ARE FUNDED BY THE GRASSROOTS. PITCH IN $5 OR $10 A MONTH TO FUEL
THIS FIGHT ALL THE WAY TO NOVEMBER.

Next up — critical primaries are fast approaching in Michigan, Missouri,
Minnesota, Massachusetts, Wisconsin, and other states — giving us a chance
to elect the largest class of progressives in Our Revolution's history.
But first - MAINE.

★ ★ ★

ALL EYES ON MAINE

Maine is on the frontlines as Democrats are racing to nominate a new
nominee for U.S. Senate. Our Revolution is proudly backing Troy Jackson to
carry the torch and the working class agenda he’s devoted his life to as a
union leader and state senate president.

On our call, Troy spoke to the urgency of the moment and turned attention
to the tragic loss of a young immigrant father and neighbor who was shot
by ICE that very same day.

So much is at stake. That’s why Our Revolution organizers are mobilizing
supporters across all 16 county meetings TODAY to elect delegates who will
nominate Troy Jackson at the state convention next week. Not only is he
the strongest champion for our values, he’s the strongest candidate to
defeat Susan Collins and flip this seat!

Democrats won't win this critical race with another handpicked
establishment candidate. We win by uniting behind a proven champion for
worker rights, reproductive rights, paid family leave, expanded
healthcare, and much more.

“This movement has always been bigger than one person,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39178?t=1014&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]Troy said on
our call. “It’s about taking on a system rigged against working people.
Solidarity isn’t just a word for me, it’s a lifestyle.”

That same spirit carried throughout this week’s National Organize-to-Win
Call, where progressive leaders from across the country shared why the
next few weeks could define the future of our movement.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39179?t=1015&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT TO HELP US NOMINATE TROY JACKSON TO FLIP THIS SENATE
SEAT IN MAINE!

★ ★ ★

THE MANY VS. THE MONEY IN MICHIGAN

Michigan’s open Senate race is one of the most closely watched races in
the country. AIPAC and other outside groups have spent tens of millions
trying to beat Dr. Abdul El-Sayed — but voters are hungry for real change.

“This race really is about the money versus the many.” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39180?t=1016&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]Abdul said on
our Monday call. “We want to get money out of politics, put money in your
pocket, and pass Medicare for All.”

Our Revolution organizers have made tens of thousands of calls to turn out
progressives to the polls — and we’re doubling down on our voter-to-voter
outreach across the state in the lead-up to Election Day Aug. 4th.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39181?t=1017&akid=11072%2E5885482%2EdO4VS2 ]SIGN UP TO MAKE CALLS FOR ABDUL

★ ★ ★

SEN. ED MARKEY: FACING A CHALLENGE

Senator Ed Markey reminds us all that defeating MAGA isn't enough — we
also have to defend the progressive leaders who have spent decades
fighting for Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, labor rights, and
economic justice.

“It's not just having Democrats in the United States Senate,” Markey said
on our Monday Call. “It’s having progressive Democrats in the United
States Senate.”

Markey is facing down a challenge from a corporate Democrat after years of
bold public service in the Senate. He still leads by 5 points in most
polls — and we will have his back as we work to send in reinforcements.

★ ★ ★

CORI BUSH: “THIS IS CORI 2.0”

After AIPAC and allied groups spent millions to defeat her, Cori Bush IS

| | Hey Peter, I’m currently getting ready to knock doors with my campaign’s Summer Democracy Fellows!

But before we get started, I wanted to tell you about why we do this work.
[](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/6Al0C76Z2blAxlXgoI6UpA~~/AAPPABA~/SgPsujgR--8_ISRUA-fDlusQKtxwYzC71PkpwEcRU9u6MBuqC2hV57iQfMCBkm7zaflb8ObI1vCI8IaPJO6g0qof0JQXvhGfzbFm1I57l45ng9_VrSzvR9vDlfEN0PwMJN6lOc-eWFHLN2QQoxJp6WFNWe9oayzay-tIkIPQyr_LhB9sofAr7aCTNS01SjjEbdzYMIItTmAhmQZxJvBhZlD1nOeQhE0IKlRaTRe-DPln5-qMdZEXZPnDK0BmmPkCGoVphChvmPSuztNdfULxlLABkEYeMkc6thAyj5VcVBVT0nkJTjhOMrgpN-LQFhZyHd22ilBRoWprddUBiLAVcIHAKGp14Q3V-zYBa0hWFRU~)
Right now, the far right is using every trick to lie and cheat their way to clinging to power.

And here’s the thing: They can do that all they want.

Because we have something they don’t: a grassroots movement that actually meets people where they’re at.

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: I know a fighter when I see one.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
Hi, it’s Nancy Pelosi.
I've spent my career fighting For The People — and building the Democratic power it takes to win those fights. Today, I’m asking for your help.
I've seen leaders come and go. I've watched some rise to the moment and others shrink from it. And after all these years, I can tell you that I know a fighter when I see one.
Raja Krishnamoorthi is a fighter.
As Speaker of the House, I appointed Raja, my dear friend and extraordinary colleague, to the Intelligence Committee, where he helped to keep our country safe and helped lead the impeachment of Donald Trump. I also appointed Raja to the Special Select Oversight Subcommittee responsible for taking on price-gouging pharmaceutical companies, investigating COVID scams and lowering healthcare costs. I worked with Raja for a decade in standing up to Big Tobacco, the gun lobby and many others who prioritize profit over our children’s health and safety.
And I watched Raja face down hatred and bigotry that would have broken a lesser person — and come back stronger every single time.
So when Raja told me he was launching Equal Opportunity Now — a new group dedicated to finding and supporting the next generation of Democratic leaders and priorities — I didn't hesitate. This is exactly what this moment demands.
Because let me be clear about what we are facing:
Donald Trump and his MAGA extremists are a danger to our Constitution, our children and our Democracy. Full stop.
They are actively working to dismantle the institutions that are the foundation of our government of, by and For The People. They are stripping away the safety net that millions of working families depend on to give massive tax breaks to their ultra rich MAGA donors on the backs of vulnerable Americans. And they are counting on us to be too tired, too divided or too discouraged to stop them.
They don't know us very well, do they? We don’t agonize — we organize!
I have spent decades building the Democratic infrastructure it takes to win — to take back the House, to protect our majorities and to deliver For the People. That is the ongoing work of my PAC to the Future. And Raja is building the bench of bold, battle-tested leaders who will carry this fight forward for decades to come with Equal Opportunity Now.
Today, I’m asking you to support Raja’s Equal Opportunity Now and my PAC to the Future. We need both as we build an America that honors the vision of our Founders, the service and sacrifice of our men and women in uniform and the dreams and aspirations of our children.
Will you split a donation of $25 or $50 between PAC to the Future and Equal Opportunity Now right now? Your support will do directly to winning the fights ahead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
SPLIT A DONATION NOW! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
I could not be more proud of Raja’s leadership and of continuing to fight alongside him for our shared values and for our Democracy. Let's get to work!
NANCY

clean_body: [] Hi, it’s Nancy Pelosi. I've spent my career fighting For The People — and building the Democratic power it takes to win those fights. Today, I’m asking for your help. I've seen leaders come and go. I've watched some rise to the moment and others shrink from it. And after all these years, I can tell you that I know a fighter when I see one. Raja Krishnamoorthi is a fighter. As Speaker of the House, I appointed Raja, my dear friend and extraordinary colleague, to the Intelligence Committee, where he helped to keep our country safe and helped lead the impeachment of Donald Trump. I also appointed Raja to the Special Select Oversight Subcommittee responsible for taking on price-gouging pharmaceutical companies, investigating COVID scams and lowering healthcare costs. I worked with Raja for a decade in standing up to Big Tobacco, the gun lobby and many others who prioritize profit over our children’s health and safety. And I watched Raja face down hatred and bigotry that would have broken a lesser person — and come back stronger every single time. So when Raja told me he was launching Equal Opportunity Now — a new group dedicated to finding and supporting the next generation of Democratic leaders and priorities — I didn't hesitate. This is exactly what this moment demands. Because let me be clear about what we are facing: Donald Trump and his MAGA extremists are a danger to our Constitution, our children and our Democracy. Full stop. They are actively working to dismantle the institutions that are the foundation of our government of, by and For The People. They are stripping away the safety net that millions of working families depend on to give massive tax breaks to their ultra rich MAGA donors on the backs of vulnerable Americans. And they are counting on us to be too tired, too divided or too discouraged to stop them. They don't know us very well, do they? We don’t agonize — we organize! I have spent decades building the Democratic infrastructure it takes to win — to take back the House, to protect our majorities and to deliver For the People. That is the ongoing work of my PAC to the Future. And Raja is building the bench of bold, battle-tested leaders who will carry this fight forward for decades to come with Equal Opportunity Now. Today, I’m asking you to support Raja’s Equal Opportunity Now and my PAC to the Future. We need both as we build an America that honors the vision of our Founders, the service and sacrifice of our men and women in uniform and the dreams and aspirations of our children. Will you split a donation of $25 or $50 between PAC to the Future and Equal Opportunity Now right now? Your support will do directly to winning the fights ahead. [] [] SPLIT A DONATION NOW! >> [] I could not be more proud of Raja’s leadership and of continuing to fight alongside him for our shared values and for our Democracy. Let's get to work! Peter,
Thursday night, Trump went on national television and spent 25 minutes undermining our elections.
No new evidence. No proof. Just the same grievances he has been recycling since 2020, repackaged as "declassified intelligence" and aimed directly at November.
We know what this is. Trump wants Congress to pass the SAVE Act, a sweeping voter suppression bill that would throw up roadblocks between millions of Americans and the ballot box. Proof of citizenship requirements. Strict voter ID mandates. Rules designed to make it harder to vote, not easier.
Thousands of you have already signed our petition saying it is too late in this election cycle to be making sweeping changes to how Americans vote. Republicans heard you. They are going forward anyway.
Colorado has been here before. We have fought back against gerrymandered maps, rigged district lines, and a political system built to keep certain voices out. This is the same fight, just on a bigger stage.
We want to know what you saw Thursday night and what you are most worried about heading into November.
Your answers will help shape how we fight back between now and Election Day.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135522286/634496435/1328794144?refcode=ea.1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmNTJiZGQ2LWI5ODItZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wZVeYPAntGXOp_joMGHDxC24uNZtpd-lh5s_ycYbaUw=&emci=24cb20f3-0e82-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)
---
Back in the 80s, I spent an unexpected night alone in Sequoia National Park after getting separated from my hiking partner. I was frightened, of course. But I also remember lying there among those ancient trees, surrounded by a world that had existed long before me, and understanding something I've carried ever since: _we are guests here._ The forest wasn't mine. It belonged to the owls I heard in the dark, the black bears, the countless creatures who had nowhere else to go. That's the thing about wildlife. We can go home. They're already home. The wilderness is the only one they have. Which is why the news last week hit me so hard. **The Trump administration just gutted the heart of the Endangered Species Act — _rewriting the definition of "harm" so that destroying an endangered animal's habitat is no longer illegal._**__ | **Trump, Ending Decades of Protection, Opens Wild Habitats to Drilling and Mining** \- The New York Times
---
Fossil fuel companies, mining interests, and developers can now bulldoze, drill, and drain the very places imperiled species depend on to eat, shelter, and raise their young.
**Environmentalists are calling it the most severe erosion of wildlife protections in half a century.**
And they're right. Scientists have told us over and over: habitat loss is the number one driver of extinction. You don't have to shoot a salamander to wipe out salamanders. You just have to drain the pond.
When this rule change was first proposed, roughly 220,000 people submitted public comments — and about 99% opposed the change. Even wildlife agencies in Republican-led states begged the administration to reconsider. Trump ignored every single one of them.
They want us to believe our voices don't matter. I know they do — and I want to hear yours.
**[**Will you take a moment today and tell me why protecting endangered species and wild places matters to you? A memory, a species you love, a place that shaped you — whatever moves you.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135522287/634496436/-1457806683?refcode=ea.1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmNTJiZGQ2LWI5ODItZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wZVeYPAntGXOp_joMGHDxC24uNZtpd-lh5s_ycYbaUw=&emci=24cb20f3-0e82-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=1f52bdd6-b982-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)**

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: This is a longer email, but it’s worth the read:
body:
Texans have lost trust in our government, and for good reason.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, it’s Gina. I want to give you an update on my campaign.
Last week, I traveled across Houston, San Antonio, and Laredo, and I heard the same thing that I’ve been hearing all across the state: **Texans are concerned about rising costs.**
Texans have lost trust in our government, and for good reason. Greg Abbott has hoarded our money and prioritized cashing checks from donors while we struggle with the costs of healthcare, electricity, groceries, gas, and housing.
**That’s why I just launched my new plan to put “Money in Your Pocket.”**
On day one as governor, I will sign a proclamation declaring the high-cost crisis an emergency in the state of Texas, and I will call on the Legislature to place on my desk a bill to send $1,500 to every Texas family.
Let me explain how we got here...
**The American Dream is slipping away in Texas.**
It used to be that if you worked hard, you could afford to put food on the table, have a family, and retire with dignity. That was the deal. You did your part, Texas did its part. _That_ was the American Dream.
But that dream has slipped away._**Because Greg Abbott is selling us out.**_
Right now, money is going into the government, and it’s coming out of the government, mostly benefiting Greg Abbott’s donors and global corporations.
At a time when Texans are facing a high-cost economy, we are all done paying for the Greg Abbott Corruption Tax.
The truth is – there’s one real fight in this country, and the fight is this: _**Is this going to be a state that is by and for the people, or is this the billionaires’ world and we just live here?**_
We’re paying into a system that is working against us. There is no trust. Our number one job is to build that trust. **We need to do everything we can to help Texas families right now. And that starts with electing a leader who will actually do that.**
**[Peter, I’m traveling all across the state to hear from Texans and bring them into this fight. If you can, chip in $5 today to help keep us on the road from now until November.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260718_1_substack.VP2YdD&refcode=em20260718-1606&amount=5&t=1&akid=1606%2E299639%2EYcZVaK)**

It’s time we put the power back in the hands of Texans.
Thank you for pitching in what you can, when you can, to my campaign.
— Gina

| | | Hi there, it's Martin Sheen. I know seeing my name in your inbox might come as a surprise, but I need to talk to you about the country we both love ‐‐ and why I hope you'll fight for it alongside me.

If you don't have time to hear my whole pitch, here's my ask: [**Will you join me in the fight for our future by donating $7 _(generously matched to $21)_ to help my friends at the DSCC take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23402?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260718-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260718-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=24864%2E9716520%2ELyAsVX)

You see, I was once the "acting" president of the United States ‐‐ and while I may have been playing a fictional role, the lessons I learned were very real.

I'll let you in on the most important one: **Every person has the power to make a difference.**

You might find that hard to believe right now, after everything we've seen and endured in the past year.

I certainly wouldn't blame you for feeling that way.

But look beyond the terrible headlines, and you might just see what I see: Americans of every background and belief, standing up in ways big and small, _sacrificing_ to bring about a future better than our present.

Whether they succeed is, in part, up to you.

One seemingly small action you can take to help is to join with your fellow Democrats and pitch in $7 to help elect a Democratic Senate majority.

Flipping the Senate and bringing accountability to this administration _will_ make a difference, but it will only be possible if we lock hands, raise our voices, and come together ‐‐ that's when we can accomplish truly incredible things.

**The headwinds we face are strong, but we are stronger. Donald Trump is determined, but we are more determined. And right now, as we stretch our arms toward the future, I hope you'll join me.**

[**I'm coming to you humbly: Before the midnight deadline passes, will you contribute $7 to the DSCC as we take the next step together? body:
Going on vacation — but our work doesn’t stop.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260718-1&t=1&akid=3740%2E587540%2EE17Lk_)
I’m finally doing it, Peter.
The thing so many of you have been telling me to do for forever: **I’m going on vacation.**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260718_1_vacation.XIHgdi&refcode=em20260718-3740&t=2&akid=3740%2E587540%2EE17Lk_)
I’ve spent the last several months going from Georgia to New York to Texas to Maryland — knocking doors with our candidates, hosting events with them, and building the momentum our movement needs to keep winning race after race.
This has been our biggest year yet at Leaders We Deserve, and there’s still so much more to come. So, I’m taking a breather.
**But honestly, stepping away for a moment doesn’t make me think about this work any less.** It actually helps me refocus and think more clearly about the tough fights we have ahead.
And there’s _a lot_ of them. Our candidates are full steam ahead until November — and so are the establishment’s attempts to stop them.
The Democratic Party is at an inflection point right now. The people who have been running this Party into the ground for decades are scared. What comes next will determine whether this movement for working people, not corporations or billionaires, is a real, unmovable force or if our momentum will slip away.
**That’s why our work can’t afford to take a vacation, even if I need to.**
**[Will you pitch in $5 to help Leaders We Deserve keep our movement strong while I’m recharging?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260718_1_vacation.XIHgdi&refcode=em20260718-3740&amount=5&t=3&akid=3740%2E587540%2EE17Lk_)**

Back soon,
David Hogg

| | | Friend,He was trusted with the most precious thing in the world. _Other people's children._ For 27 years, Dennis Jutras walked the halls of Baltimore City schools. He taught history. He mentored students. In 2005, he was named **Teacher of the Year.** **Parents trusted him.** **Children ****trusted him.** And then came the moment that revealed what was hiding beneath that trusted title.
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=90046ca8fae64810882d8c172a23c1ac&_e=Tnx89FTGiCVvOQ3iKzHui-RgpjJIcFByUqaV3UIMT5qZ460mlUKCVMo7YsRCyoEXb8Ad3w_oAUqHL_q42SnYrVtcE6X0ONliWJbOSnaQztb4PPK407xPK-yGGXWRqD0tJHqYf22Bo30fA_7nMhmqiyTEi7mim-4_bNripApyI0yjyMrVq-rf-iQAeAOvBfdMj26__N2mGEVpQkkFcH4KBjstEJDwbQPmQmXiNXhaWa6f2Hrog8PjgaOG88pfyZ9SV20IdbzYfOiVOUeDbrO2LGRjig5R_UpfWU282Z4sKJb9kdUxydztUGaHY8CipOb65q0c51Un_3-bvMmPyeEmK2Mj4z_6Rszb4giZ4Swy34LdLpvlxv82o4HTrjS9myHwQ1b978nVvnsxPEOI_-N3bvvNc7_PiVlesENjPAivXasL6am5lGNJFfVHSDI_-ftATTbJd-5nQRTF9wb9I4FuG2rO4_s_OG9Wt4F-98BlTo8quLw5VplDSKpou_UH4RSz3aQjXCqbBKZY225EP8V9T1MaWU6rnw8KngqiHAOpUUnZM3-IH68teXKSfNqnvKfPQ2dKUeQjxtZFy_JS-s67TZtc3XMnZhvKU-t-Cp2xAbkQ0RtCs5IHHoTS4ri0iVFeSkMJiWJjE2vY7-aoHKUORHNOon7LL_7Pfxj-tDojCHaQ3sLCZERT6ZOQftLOe0V27piqVJpG_6SGyX39OHOtDQ%3D%3D)

**Jutras was recently arrested after sending graphic sexual messages and explicit photos to someone he believed was a 15-year-old boy, arranging to meet that child alone at a park. **
---

But he did not meet a child. _He met law enforcement._ Thanks to a brave undercover detective and a sting operation organized by the Harford County Sheriff's Office, Jutras was taken into custody on the spot. He is now behind bars, held without bail. Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ because I believe that exposing the evil of child exploitation is one of the most urgent callings of our time. And what happened in Baltimore is exactly why **the fight has never been more urgent.** Because this predator was not lurking in the shadows.
---

He was standing at the front of a classroom. He visited multiple schools every single day. **He had direct access to children** **And no one suspected a thing.** That is the terrifying truth about child exploitation that _Sound of Freedom_ tried to show the world: _evil does not always look like evil. _ It hides behind titles. Behind smiling faces in school hallways. Behind trust. Sheriff Jeffrey Gahler said it plainly after the arrest: _"Someone's child, boy or girl, underage, is going to be criminally assaulted by these people if we're not out there intercepting them."_ **He is right. **And that is exactly why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. **

body:
We’re building political power to prepare for November.
#
Peter, this is a fire-alarm fire:
**Trump just executed an unprecedented political purge — firing the remaining members of the bipartisan U.S. Election Assistance Commission (EAC).**
_**Now, there are no members.**_
[_****_](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260718-1.hDspKr&amount=3&refcode=em20260718-393&t=1&akid=393%2E1366028%2ErNyRnM)
With less than sixteen weeks left until the critical midterm elections, this dangerous move leaves our nation’s voting oversight body completely leaderless.
**Peter, this is clearly another blatant attempt by Donald Trump to disrupt our democratic right to vote, right before people start voting.**
[**Will you rush a contribution of $3 right now to help Voto Latino fight back, scale up voter registration, and mobilize voters in key battleground districts?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260718-1.hDspKr&amount=3&refcode=em20260718-393&t=2&akid=393%2E1366028%2ErNyRnM)
This sudden ousting follows a clear, alarming pattern of trying to manipulate our elections from the top down.
First, judges blocked Trump’s attempts to force proof of citizenship onto federal voter forms. But because he couldn't control the system, he shifted tactics — weaponizing a recent Supreme Court ruling to wipe out the agency's leadership entirely.
**Peter, when bipartisan protections are targeted by politicians — especially the president — our only effective defense is building overwhelming power at the ballot box. And that’s what we’re doing _right now._**
Because of grassroots supporters like you, we’re already organizing across critical battleground states to ensure our communities are registered, informed, and completely ready for November. We refuse to allow Trump’s constant attempts to crush our democracy to undermine fair and secure elections. We must show up in numbers that he and his Republican allies simply can’t ignore.
**But this work is expensive, and we urgently need the grassroots resources required to ramp up our efforts to meet this moment.**
**[Peter, please chip in $3 today to help Voto Latino expand the Latino electorate, protect the ballot, and defend our democracy](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260718-1.hDspKr&amount=3&refcode=em20260718-393&t=3&akid=393%2E1366028%2ErNyRnM)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

body:
Thoughts on the state of the race
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260718-3046)
Peter,
In the span of ten days, candidates have dropped out, jumped back in and scrambled to reshape this race. Now, some powerful people appear to believe they can decide how this primary ends.
But this race does not belong to any one elected official, wealthy donor or political insider. It belongs to Wisconsin voters. And voters have been making their preference clear.
From the beginning, we have run an unconventional campaign. We’ve held dance parties, concerts and sign-painting nights. We’ve built a campaign rooted in joy, community and an open-door policy that welcomes everyone, not just the wealthy and powerful.
Some people have called that “unserious.”
Meanwhile, we have raised more than $1.1 million through 22,000 grassroots contributions. More than 6,000 volunteers have joined our coalition. And Wisconsin voters have put us in first place in three consecutive Marquette Law School polls.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260718.CrlKu3&refcode=em20260718-3046&t=1&akid=3046%2E105371%2El67-IV)
We are extremely serious about delivering permanent affordability for Wisconsinites. That is what democracy looks like when working people realize their power.
What’s unserious is treating a statewide election like a game of musical chairs. What’s unserious is assuming that an endorsement from the top should outweigh months of organizing from the ground up.
If anyone is playing games, it isn’t the volunteers knocking doors, making calls and giving $10 or $20 because they believe Wisconsin can do better.
We are serious about defeating Tom Tiffany. We are serious about winning a Democratic trifecta. And we are serious about lowering property taxes, fully funding our public schools, delivering universal childcare and building an economy where working people can afford to live.
No endorsement can substitute for the movement we have built together. But maintaining it through Election Day will take all of us.
[If you’re ready to show that Wisconsin’s future will be decided by its voters, please contribute $10, $20, $50 or whatever you can today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260718.CrlKu3&refcode=em20260718-3046&t=2&akid=3046%2E105371%2El67-IV)
The wealthy and powerful may have their preferred candidate. I’m proud to be the candidate of the people ready to change Wisconsin.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260718.CrlKu3&amount=5&refcode=em20260718-3046&t=5&akid=3046%2E105371%2El67-IV)**
With gratitude,
Francesca

Dear Patriot,
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4ht1K7COgqgSjooqojrIc_XmqkKkDqKLtCqwF4eGcWQWqnOXD-s3hbOXLTmDIdzGeGOqq4LUMQw8JYKPhPYWXpt_yZi8e6_jp8)When I started undercover investigative journalism as a college student at Rutgers, I pored over the history of journalism. I studied the techniques of great authors who broke stories that transformed America. From Stetson Kennedy, who infiltrated the highest echelons of the KKK in the 1940s, to Upton Sinclair, who went undercover in the 1900s working in a meatpacking plant in Chicago. Sinclair's book, The Jungle, resulted in a national uproar over food safety and the creation of what is now the Food and Drug Administration. Every notable author and journalist who came before me used similar tactics to get the story: fearless boots on the ground. And as I've found in my nearly 20 years as a journalist, my job is limited to what I can see and record through public access . . . undercover or not. At the end of each investigation, I'm left wanting more. I can see the threads dangling in front of me, waiting to be pulled, but accessible only to law enforcement and their powers to investigate. **But today, the world has shifted . . .** This morning, I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America." Following my opening remarks, where I expressed my limits as a journalist, something extraordinary happened. **Committee Chairman Rand Paul invited me to submit requests for subpoenas to his office.** Notably, Senator Paul, as the chairman of HSGAC, is the only member of the Senate with **unilateral authority** to issue subpoenas. From Upton Sinclair to Woodward and Bernstein, the model for action has been: **Journalist publishes → Institution reacts.** After my testimony before the Senate, that model will be inverted . . . **at least temporarily.** Power shifts. Rules change. **Doors close.** That's why we have to [**move fast**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4huMuyaHEprc5udB2uVh-oWabsmh9qPiFc0sAqnfYBGuSjSM--5vC7xpQUNqANE6KJadcZkUT1zolK895WM4TxGvujHhTRKsMw), and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer. I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations.
* We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots.
* We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration.
* We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal "Gain of Function" research on COVID-19.

**At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts.** Senator Paul just handed us a golden key. [**Will you help me fund this new squad?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4hvBbJBXk6sMgQT2YKjiv3yD5ZIASkRW9qPdqB_6zgBbi6Iwy-NNMGeQQyvDj5ixdoaismoc9vXYKrbvJpEy72B1I4NoLU8AfI) Remember, Al Capone was brought down by an accountant. In today's dollars, Capone's criminal enterprise was worth $2 billion. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least **$250 billion every year** on the federal level alone — money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. And at the Senate hearing on Fraud in America, our elected officials admitted that the governmental bodies tasked with stopping fraud for decades are wholly ineffective. That leaves us to do the job. Are you in? [**Help me and my team get to work.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4hwg_rjE0ae0VXy_bv6ZoiW8rJ5X2Eg4Iu0s5vLUcbJLgxF0YDyOyd9u1DzhQxoENvYEyqdMgEDMUibzdY_V9VxZTPjVlu5fzI) We have HUNDREDS of Al Capones to take down who have been ripping all of us off and stealing our national treasure . . . and our votes. **Time is short.**[**Please help me and my team get started today.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4hxiV3yXoWQbigImloQprv5LCAsDo34Sk_tnongp6kiIuyctZSoTxdZSz9K0J4UyOVTMFZfbElw-3e1vu6VCrLo_qtHY155BNE) Thank you for all that you do.
In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media Group
P.S. I'm still grasping the impact of the Senate hearing. Most journalists might just smile and say "thank you" if Senator Paul asked them to submit subpoena requests to him. But those journalists have not gone as deep as I have. They haven't risked their lives. Some never leave the comfort of their office. I know what the offer means. I've lived with the frustration of knowing that the true players behind an operation can hide in darkness. With your help, OMG is taking advantage of this immediately — until the door closes. [**Please help fund this rapid response team today.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NDF9AAwAAAAAAdKZt4hyHhnj_OtdjN60EPGH_Q5wUP-UToBYX6qxFlisZRS6FflZbRaM_UJmW1jsapx34rm3jHyjuzsQHb8G-QgDCPh3mCJ_vDz1Tfw)

I was on MSNBC earlier this week to respond to Donald Trump's primetime address.
I put it plainly: This is old news. Donald Trump lost the election fair and square and he's trying to sew distrust in the 2026 elections AND maybe even interfere in upcoming elections.
That's it. That's the whole thing.
Thursday night, the President of the United States took over primetime television to tell the country — again, six years later — that the 2020 election was rigged. He declassified a stack of documents he says prove "shocking vulnerabilities" in our elections. He floated a new allegations about China.
Twenty-five minutes. Not one piece of evidence that a single vote was changed anywhere.
It's pathetic. The President of The United States still can't say the words "I lost."
But pathetic isn't the problem. Dangerous is the problem.
We've seen this movie. In 2020, Trump told this same lie, and it ended with a mob storming the Capitol. He pardoned nearly every one of them. Now he's laying the same groundwork four months before a midterm his party is on track to lose.
He isn't relitigating 2020. He's writing his excuse for November in advance. And he's telling us, out loud, what he plans to do about it.
One more thing nobody should miss: Trump gave that address in the middle of an unauthorized war. Our military has been striking Iran six nights running. Gas prices are climbing. Analysts are warning about a forever war with no way out. By talking about China and the elections, Trump is trying to distract attention from his unpopular failures at home and abroad.
Moments like these are why I built Equal Opportunity Now. We need leaders who will defend our elections, demand answers on this war, and refuse to let a president run out the clock with a primetime temper tantrum.

**San Diego Pride is this weekend - it’s going to be great!**

Pride is a chance to celebrate how far we’ve come. It’s also a reminder that progress is never guaranteed.

**I’ve been proud to stand with San Diego’s LGBTQ+ community throughout my career.** Before serving in Congress, I served on the board of The San Diego LGBT Community Center. As San Diego City Council president, I helped lead the fight for the city to stand publicly in support of marriage equality, at a time when doing so was far from politically easy. Today, I serve as a vice chair of the Congressional LGBTQ+ Equality Caucus.

But titles matter less than the work.

I’ve fought to protect LGBTQ+ employees from discrimination by federal contractors. When President Trump tried to ban transgender Americans from serving in our military, I introduced legislation to stop him. And I secured $1.5 million to help open San Diego’s first permanent LGBTQ+-affirming shelter for young people experiencing homelessness.

That’s what equality looks like in practice: protecting people from discrimination, making sure they have somewhere safe to turn, and defending their right to live openly and authentically.

The Equality Act would take the next necessary step by explicitly protecting people from discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity under federal civil rights law.

It should be simple. Equal protection must mean equal protection for everyone.

**But with Republicans controlling Congress and the Trump Administration once again targeting transgender Americans, we cannot take that principle for granted. This weekend, in honor of San Diego PRIDE, I’m asking you to[ _add your name and stand with me in calling on Congress to pass the Equality Act._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135527043/634514754/1487594740?refcode2=SP_EM_PT_90DO_260717_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODA2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmM5YmEzNC1jMzgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Xcowfb2oVM8--3pC6IuDWA7jSR269g8a9-2Qtf_yMw=&emci=7fb57fdf-4f82-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=c6c9ba34-c382-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=5258741) **

Peter, it’s Valerie Foushee. It is an incredibly difficult time for this country. The attempts to erase history, the attacks on immigrants, and equally as devastating and further reaching: the attacks on voting rights. Following the senseless Supreme Court ruling that weakened the 1965 Voting Rights Act, Republican state legislatures nationwide are now mobilizing an effort to target Black members of Congress and Black-majority districts. For many communities across the country, it looks and feels all too familiar of a period of life in America we have fought so hard to overcome. I consider myself incredibly lucky to still be in the halls of Congress while many of my fellow Black lawmakers have not been as fortunate. That's why this campaign means so much to me. I want to lay this out plainly so you can see the choice in this race. Rob Bresnahan ran as someone who would “clean up” Washington. He promised to ban members of Congress from trading stocks, and he said he wouldn’t vote to strip healthcare from his neighbors. **Then he arrived in Washington and did the opposite.** He promised reform. Then he traded hundreds of stocks worth millions while casting votes that directly affected those industries. He publicly said he didn’t discuss trades with his advisers — then admitted on air that he does exactly that. **He told you one thing on the campaign trail and acted another way once he had power.** He promised to protect healthcare. Then he voted for the largest Medicaid cuts in history — a vote that will hit more than 30% of our district who rely on Medicaid and put rural hospitals at risk. After that vote, he sold off Pennsylvania hospital bonds. **That isn’t a mistake. It’s a pattern: using his votes for his own personal profit. ** He promised to lower costs — but his votes have helped drive them up. He supports tariffs and overseas spending that spike prices at the gas pump and the grocery store while saving himself thousands in tax breaks from the same bills. **Meanwhile, everyday families in NEPA are choosing between gas and groceries.** Now let me tell you about my record. When Scranton needed someone to stand up to the corrupt local machine, I ran as an Independent and refused the perks that come with the office. I turned down a city car, ended no-bid contracts, balanced budgets, and worked to make our city safer and our neighborhoods stronger. **I’ve earned A‐ grade credit status for our city, cut red tape so more people can open businesses and build homes, and returned taxpayer dollars where they belong.** Bresnahan treats public service as a personal payday and has made a pattern of broken promises that cost Northeastern Pennsylvanians their healthcare, their hospitals, and more of their paychecks. **I’ll fight to roll back those cuts, protect our hospitals, end congressional stock trading, and bring responsible leadership to Washington.** [**I’m asking you to help me tell this story to our neighbors. indulge the president's delusions?"

been proving he won't.

the man dangling his promotion, still hasn't. So he deflects and runs out
the clock to appease him.

That's a preview of exactly how he'll operate once he's confirmed —

It is one of the most outrageous and reckless realities in American governance: in dozens of states--including North Carolina and Virginia--men and women who have never pulled an all-nighter studying constitutional law, never passed a bar exam, and never stepped foot in a law school are given the power to decide whether accused rapists, armed robbers, and repeat violent felons walk out of jail and back onto your streets before trial. These are not judges in the traditional sense. These are [magistrates](https://substack.com/redirect/49262909-7640-4002-82ec-fc0770408beb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--low-level court officers often armed with nothing more than a four-year college degree in communications or prior work as a teacher, a football coach, or a bartender--and they are playing roulette with public safety in the most consequential doorway of the criminal justice system: the initial bail hearing...

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

That's more than triple what we raised._ **This is not an accident.** This is a coordinated, well-funded assault by the Democrat political machine -- the _same machine that has been working systematically_ , state by state, to dismantle the constitutional republic our Founders bled to build. They have targeted Texas because they know what we know _: if they flip this Senate seat, they flip the balance of power in Washington!_ These far-left political fanatics will spend as much as it takes. They'll flood Texas with cash to try to crush us. This is the playbook of people who do not believe in America. It is the playbook of those who hate America. **Remember:** They want wide-open borders. They want far-left control over our children's education. They want to pack the Supreme Court. They want Christianity gone. They want to silence dissent, crush opposition, and fundamentally transform this Nation into an unrecognizable nightmare, with malice towards every patriot who has ever stood and placed their hand over their heart... **They tried to destroy me with witch hunts. They failed.** **They tried to stop us in the primary. They failed.** **They raised $30 million to bury us.** **They will fail again --**_but only if you act right now!_ _**I need you to understand this**_**:** money in politics is not just money. It is air cover. It is television ads running in Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. It is field organizers knocking on doors in precincts across this state. Every dollar they raise that we do not match is a dollar spent convincing Texans to surrender their freedoms to Washington bureaucrats and far-left globalist interests. **We have raised $9 million since April. Hey there, it's Mandela Barnes, Democrat running for Governor in Wisconsin.
I've been visiting neighborhoods across Wisconsin, and I keep seeing the same thing: **my opponent 's yard signs are everywhere.**

Peter, did you get paid this week?
If you did, you probably know the feeling of watching your paycheck disappear faster than it used to.
Texan workers can’t wait any longer for wages to catch up to the cost of living.
In each of the 4 sessions I've served in the Texas House,I've filed legislation to raise the minimum wage . Not once has it even made it out of committee.
But what did get prioritized:
❌ Gerrymandered maps
❌ "Eliminating Sharia Law"
❌ Putting the Ten Commandments in public school classrooms
❌ Tax breaks and giveaways for billionaires and CEOs

body:
Josh Shapiro can't hide behind the Governor's office forever.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/NFMM4qMKCAg?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
For years, Josh Shapiro has acted as though the powers of the Governor’s Office exist to serve his personal interests.
Last week, a federal judge reminded him that they don’t.
In a lawsuit involving a property dispute at Josh Shapiro’s private residence, **the court ruled that Shapiro cannot simply shield himself behind the office he holds.**
The lawsuit centers on a dispute over a strip of land next to Josh Shapiro’s private residence. After negotiations with his neighbors fell apart, the dispute ended up in federal court. Shapiro tried to hide behind the office of Governor, but the court made clear that he will have to answer for his actions as a private homeowner.
This case was never about the Governor’s Office.
It was about Josh Shapiro’s personal property.
The rules should apply equally to everyone.
Whether you’re Governor of Pennsylvania or a homeowner on any street in the Commonwealth, accountability matters.
Pennsylvanians deserve leaders who respect both the law and public trust, not politicians who seem to believe the rules are different for them.

subject: I'm asking personally.

body:
This campaign is growing because of people like you. But we still have a long way to go.

| | | | | | | Hi Peter,
As Campaign Manager, I have the privilege of seeing this campaign from a perspective that most people don’t.
I see the thousands of miles that Stacy travels every week across the Commonwealth.
I see the volunteers who spend their evenings knocking doors and making phone calls.
I see the crowds at events getting bigger and the momentum continuing to build.
**I also see what it takes to win.**
Running a statewide campaign isn’t cheap. Every day, we’re making decisions about where to travel, how many voters we can reach, and how aggressively we can get our message out.

[**HELP US KEEP BUILDING MOMENTUM**](https://us.list-manage.com/TmhYBB_QzKv?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

Meanwhile, Josh Shapiro has every advantage that comes with being the incumbent. He has national donors.
He has outside groups ready to spend millions.
He has the political establishment lining up behind him.
We know we’re going to be outspent.
But campaigns aren’t won because one side has more money.
**They’re won because one side has more people willing to stand up and say I’m in.**
That’s what has brought us this far.
**And that’s what’s going to win this race.**
Every contribution – whether it’s $10, $25, or $100 – helps us reach more voters, expand our grassroots organization, and make sure Stacy’s message reaches every corner of Pennsylvania.
The truth is simple:
**If thousands of supporters each do a little, together we can accomplish something extraordinary.**
That’s how grassroots campaigns win.
**And that’s exactly how we’re going to defeat Josh Shapiro.**

[**MAKE A CONTRIBUTION**](https://us.list-manage.com/9zqaSYEEtu1?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)

Thank you for believing in this campaign and for everything you’ve done to help us build it.
Now help us finish the job.
Sincerely,
Jim T. Campaign ManagerGarrity for Governor

body:
---
Maybe you’ve seen the headlines, Derek. Trump and his allied groups have _$971 million_ on hand — more than double Democrats’ total. Republicans know that Trump’s approval rating is sinking. They’re seeing Democrats win election after election. So they’re going to attempt to _buy_ their way out of their unpopularity problem. They’ll spend every last dollar attacking Democrats on television and online. Unless we’ve got the resources to go toe-to-toe with them, that money could make a massive difference. **Our records show that you’ve engaged with messages like these before, but haven’t yet made your first contribution of 2026 to the DNC. Today’s the day we’re asking you to change that. You can use this link:** [**https://ak.democrats.org/go/63515?t=1 &akid;=8074%2E22930333%2EuQPWr-**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260718_8074_fr&refcode2=8074_22930333_uQPWr-&akid=8074%2E22930333%2EuQPWr-) We know it might not sound like $7 can compete with Republicans’ massive war chest.
