#
# **Supporting our Hometown Heroes**

Senator Hughes worked with House Democrats and Governor Shapiro to pass a new policy that will give a cost of living raise to over 80,000 retired state teachers, police, and firefighters.
**Inflation has gone up 86% since the last time these retirees received a cost of living adjustment.**
The **cost-of-living adjustment (COLA)** for our hometown heroes applies to state workers, police, and firefighters who retired before **July 2, 2001** and have received no COLA adjustment to their pension.
After decades without an adjustment, this investment will help thousands of retirees better keep pace with the rising cost of living.

* * *

The cost-of-living increase was included in the [Pennsylvania 2026-27 state budget](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17914) that was passed over the weekend. It delivers long-overdue relief for men and women who have dedicated their careers to serving our communities.

**_" Over 80,000 retired teachers, police, and firefighters have been waiting for this cost of living increase for over 20 years. These are our hometown heroes who deserve to live with dignity in their retirement. Inflation has gone up 86% since the last time these retirees received a cost of living adjustment. At a time when every dollar counts and household budgets are stretched thin, we are giving a raise to the people who have educated our children, kept our communities safe, and answered the call when emergency struck."_**
**- Senator Hughes**

* * *

Retired teachers will see an average yearly increase of **about $3,000,** while retired state employees will receive an average increase of **about $2,280 a year**. Municipal police and firefighters will receive an average yearly benefit of **$1,600 a year**.

* * *

**Stay in Touch on Social Media**
If you haven't visited Senator Hughes' [**Facebook page**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17915), join the conversation by 'liking' the page and following our office on [**Instagram**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17916), [**TikTok**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17917), [**X**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17918), and [**Bluesky**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172083.172949.312&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17919). He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — CANNOT — do this alone. So here’s what I need from you: The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. And they’re ready to bury us in negative ads and dark money. We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch. Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate. — James Carville New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

Friend,

In just a moment, we are going to ask you to fund our ballot chasers in Arizona. Please give us a chance to explain why this request – _especially today_ – is so important.

Here is the truth:

Arizona's primary election is July 21st. Early voting is already underway, and every single day between now and then matters. _We have to get our ballot chasers in front of voters right now, while there's still time to make a difference_.

Now here is why this actually matters:

**Arizona isn't just another swing state. It's the single most important state on the map.** The state carries 11 electoral votes, soon to be 12, and without winning it, most of the realistic paths to the White House disappear. If Arizona doesn't hold, the odds of keeping America First in power collapse with it.

That's not a talking point. That's math.

Winning Arizona now doesn't just decide one election. It protects Republican pathways in 2028 and beyond, and it's the difference between building on President Trump's mandate or watching it get erased.

But we need to fund the ballot chasers who make it happen. Right now.

Every $50 we raise sponsors a ballot chaser for a single day in the field – knocking on doors, building real relationships, and chasing every ballot before July 21st.

Contribute $50 to make sure the radical left does not steal the election.

Contribute $50 because every dollar goes directly to boots on the ground in Arizona – not consultants, not TV ads.

## **Friends --**
You've noticed the emails we've sent this week were short. Two paragraphs, a link, done. This one is different. I'm asking for ten minutes of your time, because before this sale ends tomorrow night, I want to make the full case--not the elevator pitch, the real one.
Here it is: Blue Amp Media is moving toward more of a paid model. Not because we want to lock the doors. **Because independent media has exactly one funding source that can 't be bought, bullied, or waited out--**_**you**_. The predator class funds plenty of media. It will never fund its own opposition. _That has to be us, together, or it doesn 't happen at all._
[Right now, through tomorrow night, every plan is 25 percent off](https://substack.com/redirect/403c8073-e41e-4fb7-bba5-468407fccfa4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Monthly, annual, all of it. And before the window closes, I want to show you exactly what a paid membership buys. Not with adjectives. With receipts.
**So here are six pieces from the last eight weeks. Six different writers and shows. Six different beats. Six different ways of seeing the same fight. Every one of them either broke news, reframed a story the big outlets botched, or said the thing nobody else would say.**
## **[1. "This Isn't a Recession. It's Worse."](https://substack.com/redirect/a8aa8ef2-dc72-455b-bf12-74ecc633012d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--Lawrence Winnerman**

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 18, 2026
McGuire: Bipartisan Momentum Building for Albemarle Investigation, Perriello Noticeably Silent
"Nine days ago I wrote to Governor Spanberger and Attorney General Jones and asked them to launch a full-scale investigation into how Albemarle County Public Schools handled these cases. The Governor's office has now weighed in, and today three Democratic legislators, Senator Deeds, Delegate Callsen, and Delegate Laufer, sent their own letter making the same demand of the School Board. I welcome every one of them to this effort. Protecting children is not a Republican issue or a Democrat issue, and I am glad to see this becoming a bipartisan call.
"The Governor's office says it is assessing all avenues. I would respectfully urge her to move from assessing to acting. Parents in Albemarle County have waited long enough. A staff member was under criminal investigation in January. Parents did not learn of it until June, when they read it in the news. The School Board itself was not told until the day before the arrest. Those facts demand a real, independent accounting -- who knew, when they knew, and why families were kept in the dark.
"One voice is conspicuously missing. Tom Perriello wants to represent this community in Congress, and he has said nothing -- not a word for these children, not a word for these families. Silence is a choice. If he cannot find the courage to speak when children in this community have been hurt, voters are entitled to ask what exactly he intends to stand up for.
"Mr. Perriello, join us. Add your name to the call for an independent investigation. The families of Albemarle County are watching, and they deserve better than silence."

As someone raised by two working-class parents...

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135533885/634536830/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMmM2M2RjMC1kNjgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bn3yDKMpllGegK18dku9y5vaPjVNraQLuQLHPvDq0Mw=) Team, As someone raised by two working-class parents, I saw the difficult choices my parents had to make just to get food on the table for me and my sister. So when I ran for Congress, I promised myself and the people of OR-06 that **I would do everything in my power to shape a stronger, better future for working families like mine.** [_**We’ve been able to make some incredible progress over the past few years, but there’s still so much work left to be done. Can you pitch in today to help me protect this seat, put Democrats on the path to flipping the House, and give us our best shot at delivering real reforms for hardworking folks across Oregon?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135533886/634536831/1480016760?amounts=6%2C15%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500&refcode=email_071826_families&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMmM2M2RjMC1kNjgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bn3yDKMpllGegK18dku9y5vaPjVNraQLuQLHPvDq0Mw=) | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135533887/634536832/1480016760?amounts=6%2C15%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500&refcode=email_071826_families&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMmM2M2RjMC1kNjgyLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bn3yDKMpllGegK18dku9y5vaPjVNraQLuQLHPvDq0Mw=)

The fact is, families shouldn’t have to think twice about getting healthy, affordable food to feed their household.
Families shouldn’t have to think twice about going to the doctor to get access to the care they need.
Families shouldn’t have to think twice about ensuring their children get the best possible resources they need in school to set them up for success.
_**But under this current administration and their manufactured affordability crisis, families are suffering.**_
From destroying our nation’s most effective food assistance programs to reckless tariffs that are hiking energy costs, Donald Trump is making it unnecessarily hard for working families to thrive in our country.

subject: I’m proud to endorse Sarah Trone Garriott

body:
Sarah is a minister, a working mom, and a proven leader who has dedicated her life to serving others.
#
Peter,
I’m proud to endorse Sarah Trone Garriott for Congress in Iowa.
Sarah is a minister, a working mom, and a proven leader who has dedicated her life to serving others. Now, she’s running to make sure working families have a voice in Washington.
[**Can you help her win by splitting a donation between her campaign and Small Town PAC today?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260718-stg.w9JMfq&amount=5&refcode=em20260718-873&t=2&akid=873%2E34582%2EaZoayZ)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260718-stg.w9JMfq&amount=5&refcode=20260718-873&t=3&akid=873%2E34582%2EaZoayZ)**
Sarah knows firsthand how difficult it can be to make ends meet. She put herself through college working at Walmart, waiting tables, cleaning hotel rooms, and taking whatever odd jobs she could find.
She began her career supporting survivors of domestic violence through AmeriCorps and went on to work in women’s shelters, serve families as a hospital chaplain, become an ordained Lutheran pastor, and lead efforts to fight hunger across the Des Moines area.
**That same call to service led Sarah to run for office when she saw that Iowa’s elected leaders weren’t listening to the people they represented.**
In 2020, she flipped a Republican-held seat in the Iowa State Senate. Two years later, she took on the Republican Senate president and beat him by three points in a district the Republican governor carried by seven. Then she won _again_ in 2024, even as Donald Trump carried her district.
Sarah doesn’t just talk about competing everywhere. She’s proven she can bring people together and win in tough territory.
She understands the pressures working families face because she has lived them. And she understands her community because she never stops showing up, listening, and working alongside the people she represents.
Sarah knows how to win tough races, and I believe she can win this one. But it will take all of us standing with her.
[**Peter, will you join me in supporting Sarah by splitting $5 between her campaign and Small Town PAC to help send a proven champion for working families to Congress?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260718-stg.w9JMfq&amount=5&refcode=em20260718-873&t=4&akid=873%2E34582%2EaZoayZ)

Thank you,
Tim Walz

Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I wanted to share an update with you.
I keep hearing versions of the same thing from so many folks:
🚨 It’s getting harder to afford things from gas to groceries.
🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seem unthinkable.
🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and politicians in Washington DC don’t seem to care.**
That upsets me, Peter – and I’m ready to get to the U.S. Senate and help fix what’s broken. I know how to deliver results because that’s what I did for eight years as Governor.
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.
✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.
✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**We have a shot at bringing some North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. Republican dark-money super PACs are pouring over $100 million so far into this race to defeat me, and recent polling shows our lead has been cut in _half_.**
[**_Please, Peter, the only way I can fight back is with grassroots support from folks like you. Will you chip in $5 or any amount today to help me take on the GOP, flip North Carolina’s Senate seat and ensure Democrats win back the majority?**_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk820&amount=5&t=9&akid=2186%2E124072%2E5xZJqL)

Roy Cooper

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Big Tech is infiltrating our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
AI companies and billion-dollar corporations shouldn’t be able to buy influence in our elections.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260718-6484-footer&t=1&akid=6484%2E420207%2EiOvbch)
Peter, right now it feels like our democracy belongs to the highest bidder.
Billion-dollar corporations, including some of the largest AI companies in the world, are spending enormous sums to influence our elections and shape the policies that govern all of us.
**They're spending millions to protect their profits, weaken oversight, and stack the deck against working families.**
That's why I'm proud to sponsor the **We The People Amendment** to overturn _Citizens United_ and finally get big money out of politics once and for all.
That’s why I've never accepted a dime from corporate PACs. Because I don't work for billionaires, powerful corporations, or special interests.
That’s why I fight for the working people who sent me to Congress. Because I fight for _all of us._
**But standing up to corporate power isn't easy.**
The corporations pouring money into our political system have virtually unlimited resources, and I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to help me fight back.
[**If you believe our elections should belong to voters, not corporations, will you chip in $3 today to help me continue this fight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260718.0pQ5Gr&refcode=em20260718-6484&amount=3&t=2&akid=6484%2E420207%2EiOvbch)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260718.0pQ5Gr&amount=3&refcode=em20260718-6484&t=21&akid=6484%2E420207%2EiOvbch)**
Together, we can build a democracy where every voice matters — not just the wealthiest ones.
Thank you,
Pramila Jayapal

Speaker Mike Johnson is coming to Southwest Washington.
Not to meet with local small business owners, tour a manufacturing plant, or hear from families struggling with the cost of living — but to raise money for my opponent.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

That tells you everything you need to know about what's at stake.
The Speaker of the House only spends his time campaigning in districts that could decide control of Congress — and this is one of them.
This seat is one of the most competitive in America — and Republican leadership knows that if they replace me with someone who falls in line, it'll be one more reliable vote for their agenda.
I've never been that kind of member of Congress. I didn't come to Washington to work for party leaders. I came to work for Southwest Washington.
That means voting the way I believe is right, even when it frustrates Democrats or Republicans. Fighting to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. Refusing corporate PAC money.
Now, Mike Johnson is coming to town to help my opponent convince voters they'd rather have someone who answers to House leadership.
I [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] think Southwest Washington deserves better than that. So before Speaker Johnson arrives next month, I'm asking for your help. Will you make a contribution today to help us show that Southwest Washington isn't for sale? Every dollar helps us keep this seat in the hands of someone who answers to this community — not to Washington leadership. This week, we're spotlighting endorsements in two states where Forward Party has earned party status.

| | | [ ](www.forwardparty.com)

### Peter —
This week, we're spotlighting endorsements in two states where Forward Party has earned party status. It is not a fast process and requires meeting state-specific requirements for voter registration, petition thresholds at the organizational level, plus a sustained presence in the states' politics over time. It is strong foundational building by Forward that changes everything for our candidates. In Colorado and Minnesota specifically, for endorsed candidates Celeste Landry and Jay Reeves, that ballot line means they can bypass ballot access hurdles and focus on reaching voters. There are certain government jobs whose entire purpose depends on the nonpartisan execution of duty. Celeste Landry, running for Colorado Secretary of State, and Jay Reeves, running for Minnesota State Auditor, are running because they understand the importance of those holders of these offices remaining loyal to the citizens first and foremost. Both are running as Forward candidates, which mean they are also bringing the right values and credibility with them. |
## **Colorado**
**Celeste Landry** Candidate for Secretary of State Forward Party Ballot Line
---
Celeste Landry has been working on election integrity and voter rights in Colorado for more than two decades as a civic advocate who shows up for the process itself. She's been a member of the League of Women Voters, testified before the Colorado legislature on voting rights legislation, and spent years identifying the unintended consequences of election laws that sound neutral but aren't. She has worked with legislators from both parties and pushed back on both when she believed they were making things harder for voters. Her platform as Secretary of State is built on three pillars: the right to vote, better representation, and election integrity.
The Secretary of State is Colorado's top election official. Celeste Landry's argument is direct: elections belong to the voters, not to political parties, not to special interests, and not to whoever happens to be in power. That office exists to protect the integrity of the process for everyone. She is running to do exactly that.
## **Minnesota**
**Major Jay Reeves (Ret.)** Candidate for State Auditor Forward Party Ballot Line
---
Jay Reeves grew up in a union family and earned his work ethic the hard way. He spent nearly 17 years serving in the United States Army as a lab scientist and data analyst. He is now running for State Auditor because, as he puts it, the job requires someone who follows the numbers, not the politics. His background speaks for itself: union labor, independent small business ownership as a truck driver, and nearly two decades of military healthcare leadership and data analytics. He brings a combination of experiences that is genuinely rare in a government oversight candidate and entirely suited to an office whose job is to audit public finances without fear or favor.
His platform is built on independence, transparency, data integrity, accountability, and technology modernization. He wants to build a modern data dashboard with township-level detail, create a standardized statewide reporting system, and ensure that fraud is reported to the right authorities with the law driving every decision. Jay Reeves has spent his entire adult life in service without an agenda. That is what the State Auditor's office requires.
### **This is What Forward Party Infrastructure Actually Looks Like**
It gives candidates who want to run outside the two-party system a real path forward. Without a party ballot line, independent candidates such as Landry and Reeves would face strict petition requirements, thousands of required signatures, and tight deadlines just to earn the right to appear on a ballot. The Forward Party's ballot line removes those barriers entirely. Instead of spending their time and resources fighting to get on the ballot, they can put their energy into actually reaching the voters.
The Forward Party's ballot lines in Colorado and Minnesota are proof that alternative exist. Every candidate who runs on them is evidence that the path is real and that voters can have more choices.
Celeste Landry and Jay Reeves are not just good candidates. They are proof of what this infrastructure is built for.
**Please forward this to your friends, family, and coworkers. It helps us introduce them to Forward and to what we are building. Also consider inviting them to one of our upcoming events listed below. We'd love to meet them.**

It is not a fast process and requires meeting state-specific requirements for voter registration, petition thresholds at the organizational level, plus a sustained presence in the states' politics over time. It is strong foundational building by Forward that changes everything for our candidates. In Colorado and Minnesota specifically, for endorsed candidates Celeste Landry and Jay Reeves, that ballot line means they can bypass ballot access hurdles and focus on reaching voters. There are certain government jobs whose entire purpose depends on the nonpartisan execution of duty. Celeste Landry, running for Colorado Secretary of State, and Jay Reeves, running for Minnesota State Auditor, are running because they understand the importance of those holders of these offices remaining loyal to the citizens first and foremost. Both are running as Forward candidates, which mean they are also bringing the right values and credibility with them. | Colorado Celeste Landry Candidate for Secretary of State Forward Party Ballot Line Celeste Landry has been working on election integrity and voter rights in Colorado for more than two decades as a civic advocate who shows up for the process itself. She's been a member of the League of Women Voters, testified before the Colorado legislature on voting rights legislation, and spent years identifying the unintended consequences of election laws that sound neutral but aren't. She has worked with legislators from both parties and pushed back on both when she believed they were making things harder for voters. Her platform as Secretary of State is built on three pillars: the right to vote, better representation, and election integrity. The Secretary of State is Colorado's top election official. Celeste Landry's argument is direct: elections belong to the voters, not to political parties, not to special interests, and not to whoever happens to be in power. That office exists to protect the integrity of the process for everyone. She is running to do exactly that. Minnesota Major Jay Reeves (Ret.) Candidate for State Auditor Forward Party Ballot Line Jay Reeves grew up in a union family and earned his work ethic the hard way. He spent nearly 17 years serving in the United States Army as a lab scientist and data analyst. He is now running for State Auditor because, as he puts it, the job requires someone who follows the numbers, not the politics. His background speaks for itself: union labor, independent small business ownership as a truck driver, and nearly two decades of military healthcare leadership and data analytics. He brings a combination of experiences that is genuinely rare in a government oversight candidate and entirely suited to an office whose job is to audit public finances without fear or favor. His platform is built on independence, transparency, data integrity, accountability, and technology modernization. He wants to build a modern data dashboard with township-level detail, create a standardized statewide reporting system, and ensure that fraud is reported to the right authorities with the law driving every decision. Jay Reeves has spent his entire adult life in service without an agenda. That is what the State Auditor's office requires. This is What Forward Party Infrastructure Actually Looks Like It gives candidates who want to run outside the two-party system a real path forward. Without a party ballot line, independent candidates such as Landry and Reeves would face strict petition requirements, thousands of required signatures, and tight deadlines just to earn the right to appear on a ballot. The Forward Party's ballot line removes those barriers entirely. Instead of spending their time and resources fighting to get on the ballot, they can put their energy into actually reaching the voters. The Forward Party's ballot lines in Colorado and Minnesota are proof that alternative exist. Every candidate who runs on them is evidence that the path is real and that voters can have more choices. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Texas Public Education is failing, Peter. And it’s not by accident.
body:
Every student deserves a fair shot at success, but they need the resources to do so.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Right now, we are paying into a system that’s working against us. My plan as governor is simple:**Save Texas schools.**
**Texas families deserve public schools that have the resources to help _every_ student succeed.**
Instead, Greg Abbott and his allies have spent years starving our neighborhood schools while _**diverting billions of taxpayer dollars away** _from the classrooms that educate the overwhelming majority of Texas children.
The system isn't failing by accident — it's being pushed in the wrong direction.
Parents are watching their children lose opportunities because **politicians have chosen to play politics with public education instead of investing in it.**
This fall, we can choose a different path.
As Governor, **from day one** , I'll fight to put public education first by investing in our neighborhood schools, supporting our teachers, and making sure every child — no matter their zip code — has access to the education they deserve.
**Because when we invest in our public schools, we're investing in the future of Texas.**
But taking on Greg Abbott and the special interests attacking public education won't be easy. I’m going to need your help to take on Abbott.

subject: Tell Formula 1 to ban tobacco sponsorships that appeal to kids
body:
"FFS, if you're partnering with Disney, Hot Wheels, and Lego, keep tobacco out of the mix"
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Tell Formula 1 to End Tobacco Sponshorships that Appeal to Kids](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te509e9dc-5e4f-4a33-9eae-9d14f876ef9c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5f0b4734-554e-47f4-9fe4-29e82dc4c0f6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)Formula 1 has a huge fan base among kids and teens, and they're partnering with brands like Disney, Lego and Hot Wheels to expand this youth audience even further. At the same time, tobacco companies are reaching millions of these young fans by sponsoring F1 teams to promote their nicotine pouches – products that are rising in popularity among young people. Philip Morris International is sponsoring the Ferrari team to promote its Zyn pouches, while British American Tobacco sponsors the McLaren team with its Velo brand. By allowing tobacco companies to promote their harmful and addictive products on cars and drivers, F1 is complicit in the tobacco industry's efforts to hook kids. This must end. The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, **the world watched, then largely moved on.** But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. **In some ways, it was only the beginning.** Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear.

I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** is to **stop the sale of God's children.** We do that through five pillars:
---
* **Prevention**
* **Intervention**
* **Education**
* **Information**
* **Influence**

---
We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to:
---
* Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster.
* Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety.
* Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free.
* Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified.
* Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet.

clean_body: Displaced, alone, and being watched by the wrong people After the earthquakes in Venezuela, traffickers are already moving. Here's how we're responding. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, the world watched, then largely moved on. But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. In some ways, it was only the beginning. Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear. We've set an urgent goal to raise $50,000 in the next 30 days to help rescue children, provide safe shelter, and reunite families before more children disappear into trafficking. Every gift brings us one step closer.Will you help us reach this lifesaving goal today? I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the Sound of Freedom Foundation is to stop the sale of God's children. We do that through five pillars: Prevention Intervention Education Information Influence We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to: Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster. Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety. Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free. Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified. Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet. "Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked." (Psalm 82:3-4) That command is what guides every decision this Foundation makes. It is not a suggestion. It is not poetry. It is an instruction, and I take it as one. We're trusting God to help us raise $50,000 in the next 30 days, but He often answers prayers through people willing to act. I hope you'll be one of them today. Peter, I am asking you urgently, humbly, and personally to make your first gift today. Please do not wait. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Right now, a displaced child in Venezuela is being watched by someone who does not have their best interest at heart. Your gift today helps make sure someone who does gets there first. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

name: Elizabeth For Virgina
subject: The Cost of Leadership Is Measured in Lives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elizabeth For Virginia
body:
2 are dead...

| | | | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/SSPF31YPrRr?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)
| | **Supporting our troops means more than praising or their sacrifice after they are killed. It means refusing to send them into an unnecessary war in the first place.**
---
| |
# Iran strikes Jordan
# Two service members are dead, One missing and Four MIA.
---
| | Today, two American service members were killed in Jordan. Others were wounded, and another remains missing. Before we debate politics, strategy, or policy, we must first recognize what has been lost.
My prayers are with their families, their friends, and every soldier, sailor, airman, Marine, Guardian, and loved one carrying the weight of this tragedy. There are spouses whose worlds have been turned upside down, parents receiving the call they have always feared, children who will grow up with memories instead of moments, and units now mourning brothers and sisters they trained beside.
As a veteran, these moments are deeply personal. I know what it means to pack a rucksack and trust that the people making decisions in Washington have done everything possible to ensure your mission is necessary, achievable, and worth the risk. Every service member understands there is danger in the profession of arms. What we should never accept is unnecessary danger created by poor leadership.
Make no mistake- this war was a choice. It was not forced upon us. The decision to escalate this conflict belongs to the President and to the civilian leaders responsible for directing our military. That responsibility carries enormous weight because every order issued in Washington is ultimately carried out by young Americans in uniform.
Leadership is not measured by how quickly you can employ military force. Leadership is measured by knowing when force is truly necessary, when diplomacy has been exhausted, and when the costs outweigh the strategic benefits.
Today, America is paying those costs.
As someone who served as an Armor officer, I also worry about what this conflict means for our long-term national security. Military readiness is not simply about having the strongest soldiers in the world. It is about maintaining the industrial capacity, logistics, and munitions necessary to deter future conflicts.
Over the past year, the United States has drawn heavily from its inventories of precision-guided munitions and air-defense interceptors while supporting allies and responding to crises in multiple regions. Military leaders and defense experts have repeatedly warned that replenishing many of these systems takes years—not months. We cannot assume that America’s industrial base can instantly replace every missile we fire.
That matters because our military must prepare for more than one contingency at a time.
We continue to deter aggression in the Indo-Pacific. We support our NATO allies in Europe. We maintain commitments in the Middle East while defending our homeland. Every time we consume finite resources without a clearly defined strategic objective, we reduce our flexibility to respond to the next crisis.
National security is not measured by how many missiles we launch. It is measured by whether America is stronger, safer, and better prepared tomorrow than we were yesterday.
We are moving in the opposite direction.
Congress has a constitutional responsibility to debate and authorize war. That responsibility exists for a reason. The framers understood that sending Americans into combat should never become routine or politically convenient. It should require public debate, strategic clarity, and accountability.
Instead, we have watched a dangerous pattern of escalation with no clearly articulated end state, no measurable definition of success, and no honest conversation with the American people about the costs.
Those costs are measured in lives.
Supporting our troops is not about standing behind a podium after tragedy strikes and thanking them for their service. Supporting our troops means exercising the discipline to avoid unnecessary wars, ensuring they are properly equipped when conflict is unavoidable, and refusing to spend American lives without a clear mission and a plan worthy of their sacrifice.
I will always stand with the men and women who wear our nation’s uniform.
That is precisely why I will continue speaking out when I believe our civilian leaders have failed them. The Department of Defense is being lead by a drunk, Fox host who is worried about testosterone instead of logistics; an insecure man child who fires anyone who challenging or his ego. Our troops are paying the price, our children’s future is paying the price.
Today, we mourn.
Tomorrow, we must demand accountability.
For the families grieving tonight, know this: your loved ones mattered. Their service mattered. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten, and neither should the decisions that placed them in harm’s way.
May God comfort those who mourn, protect those still serving, and grant our nation the wisdom to choose a different oath forward these midterm elections.
---
| | As we mourn these brave Americans, let us not allow their sacrifice to become just another headline. Call your members of Congress and demand accountability, constitutional leadership, and a clear path away from another unnecessary war. Our nation is grieving alongside more Gold Star families —families who have given more than any of us could ever be asked to give. They deserve not only our prayers, but our support, our gratitude, and our promise that we will fight just as hard for peace and responsible leadership as their loved ones fought for our country.

It means refusing to send them into an unnecessary war in the first place. | | Iran strikes Jordan Two service members are dead, One missing and Four MIA. | | Today, two American service members were killed in Jordan. Others were wounded, and another remains missing. Before we debate politics, strategy, or policy, we must first recognize what has been lost. My prayers are with their families, their friends, and every soldier, sailor, airman, Marine, Guardian, and loved one carrying the weight of this tragedy. There are spouses whose worlds have been turned upside down, parents receiving the call they have always feared, children who will grow up with memories instead of moments, and units now mourning brothers and sisters they trained beside. As a veteran, these moments are deeply personal. I know what it means to pack a rucksack and trust that the people making decisions in Washington have done everything possible to ensure your mission is necessary, achievable, and worth the risk. Every service member understands there is danger in the profession of arms. What we should never accept is unnecessary danger created by poor leadership. Make no mistake- this war was a choice. It was not forced upon us. The decision to escalate this conflict belongs to the President and to the civilian leaders responsible for directing our military. That responsibility carries enormous weight because every order issued in Washington is ultimately carried out by young Americans in uniform. Leadership is not measured by how quickly you can employ military force. Leadership is measured by knowing when force is truly necessary, when diplomacy has been exhausted, and when the costs outweigh the strategic benefits. Today, America is paying those costs. As someone who served as an Armor officer, I also worry about what this conflict means for our long-term national security. Military readiness is not simply about having the strongest soldiers in the world. It is about maintaining the industrial capacity, logistics, and munitions necessary to deter future conflicts. Over the past year, the United States has drawn heavily from its inventories of precision-guided munitions and air-defense interceptors while supporting allies and responding to crises in multiple regions. Military leaders and defense experts have repeatedly warned that replenishing many of these systems takes years—not months. We cannot assume that America’s industrial base can instantly replace every missile we fire. That matters because our military must prepare for more than one contingency at a time. We continue to deter aggression in the Indo-Pacific. We support our NATO allies in Europe. We maintain commitments in the Middle East while defending our homeland. Every time we consume finite resources without a clearly defined strategic objective, we reduce our flexibility to respond to the next crisis. National security is not measured by how many missiles we launch. It is measured by whether America is stronger, safer, and better prepared tomorrow than we were yesterday. We are moving in the opposite direction. Congress has a constitutional responsibility to debate and authorize war. That responsibility exists for a reason. The framers understood that sending Americans into combat should never become routine or politically convenient. It should require public debate, strategic clarity, and accountability. Instead, we have watched a dangerous pattern of escalation with no clearly articulated end state, no measurable definition of success, and no honest conversation with the American people about the costs. Those costs are measured in lives. Supporting our troops is not about standing behind a podium after tragedy strikes and thanking them for their service. Supporting our troops means exercising the discipline to avoid unnecessary wars, ensuring they are properly equipped when conflict is unavoidable, and refusing to spend American lives without a clear mission and a plan worthy of their sacrifice. I will always stand with the men and women who wear our nation’s uniform. That is precisely why I will continue speaking out when I believe our civilian leaders have failed them. The Department of Defense is being lead by a drunk, Fox host who is worried about testosterone instead of logistics; an insecure man child who fires anyone who challenging or his ego. Our troops are paying the price, our children’s future is paying the price. Today, we mourn. Tomorrow, we must demand accountability. For the families grieving tonight, know this: your loved ones mattered. Their service mattered. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten, and neither should the decisions that placed them in harm’s way. May God comfort those who mourn, protect those still serving, and grant our nation the wisdom to choose a different oath forward these midterm elections. | | As we mourn these brave Americans, let us not allow their sacrifice to become just another headline. Call your members of Congress and demand accountability, constitutional leadership, and a clear path away from another unnecessary war. Our nation is grieving alongside more Gold Star families —families who have given more than any of us could ever be asked to give. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, **the world watched, then largely moved on.** But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. **In some ways, it was only the beginning.** Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear.

I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** is to **stop the sale of God's children.** We do that through five pillars:
---
* **Prevention**
* **Intervention**
* **Education**
* **Information**
* **Influence**

---
We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to:
---
* Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster.
* Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety.
* Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free.
* Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified.
* Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet.

Here's how we're responding. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, The earthquakes in Venezuela dominated the news for a matter of days. The collapsed buildings, the death toll, the rescue teams pulling survivors from the rubble, the world watched, then largely moved on. But for the children left behind, the danger didn't end when the ground stopped shaking. In some ways, it was only the beginning. Displacement does something traffickers understand better than almost anyone. It breaks the systems that normally protect a child -- records, schools, familiar faces, parents who never let go of their hand. In that broken space, a stranger offering "help," a ride, a promise of safety somewhere else, can be all it takes for a child to disappear. We've set an urgent goal to raise $50,000 in the next 30 days to help rescue children, provide safe shelter, and reunite families before more children disappear into trafficking. Every gift brings us one step closer.Will you help us reach this lifesaving goal today? I've sat with survivors. I've heard what it costs a family to lose a child this way, and what it takes to bring one home. And I've learned that disasters like the one in Venezuela don't create new evil, they simply hand existing evil an opening it has used again and again. If this is the first time you're hearing from me, my name is Eduardo Verastegui, and I produced the film Sound of Freedom. The film Sound of Freedom was truly a movie that launched a movement. That movement is now. Our mission at the Sound of Freedom Foundation is to stop the sale of God's children. We do that through five pillars: Prevention Intervention Education Information Influence We are working urgently, with trusted partners on the ground, to: Find children who have already fallen into trafficking, including exploitation happening online in the chaos of the disaster. Support rescue operations that bring a child out of danger and into safety. Provide a safe bed the moment a child is free. Fund reunification when a family can be found and verified. Walk alongside a child through long-term care when there is nowhere safe to send them yet. "Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed. Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked." (Psalm 82:3-4) That command is what guides every decision this Foundation makes. It is not a suggestion. It is not poetry. It is an instruction, and I take it as one. We're trusting God to help us raise $50,000 in the next 30 days, but He often answers prayers through people willing to act. I hope you'll be one of them today. Peter, I am asking you urgently, humbly, and personally to make your first gift today. Please do not wait. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Right now, a displaced child in Venezuela is being watched by someone who does not have their best interest at heart. Your gift today helps make sure someone who does gets there first. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Friend,
Many are thinking that the election is "This Fall" and may not be engaging yet, believing there is time.

But the course of our State and Nation will begin to be determined **in only 60 days** when mail-in ballots begin to be mailed out to voters.

**_There is truly no time to waste_**. Once funds are donated, it takes several days at best to turn those around into voter contact.

24 hours from now, my wife and I and our campaign director Patience Faith begin three days of meetings with our nation's top Governors who have promised to help our campaign. They are concerned about Wes Moore and want us to win.

subject: I have never been for sale

body:
If groups want to influence our politics, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41513%2E3422442%2E7uUDud)
Peter,
When I was first elected to Congress, I attended a reception for new Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said:
**“Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.”**
I asked him why. _He said it was because I didn’t take corporate donations._
Since that day, I’ve said clearly—**if groups want to influence our politics, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.**
Too many politicians are bought by corporations to help their bottom line. What we need instead are more leaders with fresh ideas and a real plan to lower costs for working families.
That’s why I have never taken a dime from corporate PACs. It’s the only way to ensure our values are _never_ compromised by big money and special interests.
Truth to Power is powered by real people. And every single donation makes a difference. Your support has kept us focused on making life better for everyday Americans, and that doesn’t change now.
**[If you’re ready to help us fight for good ideas instead of corporate handouts, I’m asking you to chip in $5 to Truth to Power right now.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260718_1_ak.Rizui5&refcode=em20260718-41513&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41513%2E3422442%2E7uUDud)**

| Peter,
On Election Day, the phones at Louisiana Democratic Party headquarters in Baton Rouge started ringing at 6 a.m. and never stopped.
Hundreds of calls flooded our voter protection hotline from across the state during last Saturday's primary elections. The calls described the same story over and over: requesting a Democratic ballot but receiving a Republican ballot, voters unable to cast a ballot in the Senate primary, No Party voters receiving the incorrect forms to fill out, and many voters leaving polling locations altogether because they were so frustrated with the process.
This chaos was not an accident. As one LSU political scientist put it, Governor Landry created a system that was "almost designed in a lab to discourage people from participating in the electoral process." Our own executive director Dadrius Lanus called it what it was: voter suppression and voter intimidation.
This is what MAGA control of Louisiana elections looks like.
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qt1iidcfrvaC6ypgXvJra0TG2VWWCTTl_XPQBrHs7ZRGNTaQUqoS_2Bjh8Xhzzmmkm2yI56IfYR58sj0G9ltgxJSoH2nhKqmKcllJl804YWeIDf2euOWsu9xtyQE3vyrAQoGlxhgj-dn_UtPHQrd3tMCktRQ5k5KfGjjSV4i_h1ZKFGK13-cdfuuyBot2qpwl4d2eXyJtGNG8_LAZCye35f3wUvV-ZoXl1Wtww9-2YM=&c=0NW76jQ98XOjVXhFzjpwpH2oBP6qzpny9qAPG758dNY47f342oPwFw==&ch=bf2FWHcds1ir8YI0e5zysZyecxQQe731avKO8ojlv-Bs1_2I-trgsQ==)
---
That is exactly why we are building Organize Louisiana -- the largest voter education and turnout operation this state has ever seen. Ahead of the midterms, we will be in every corner of Louisiana educating voters on their rights, how to register, how to vote, and what to do when someone tries to stop them.
After this fiasco, we also need to expand the amount of poll watchers and volunteers on the ground who can report issues at polling locations back to our headquarters immediately on Election Day. No Louisiana voter should ever walk away from a polling place without their ballot being counted.
But we cannot do this alone. The Louisiana Democratic Party is one of the most underfunded state parties in the nation. We are asking Democrats from across the country to help us fund this unprecedented operation. That's why we're asking you today: [Can we count on you to rush a donation of $25, $10, or even just $5 to help us counter MAGA's voter suppression in Louisiana?](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001qt1iidcfrvaC6ypgXvJra0TG2VWWCTTl_XPQBrHs7ZRGNTaQUqoS_2Bjh8Xhzzmmaj5cdYpauWc0GZu_g79aLD_PZ8SuZcz0d-viXE4rut9pLXRF1wn2UMtgmDmXLg7D6dnyjMKs9ymnVL1s1QbzuoBw-jPcn9sds1k5GCc6s5gtjrwBfD0y_EETaQusTbw3RXO-xEwaWFYetSkSg3dBFKPKIdmn6S33U_ko_bVWKFENSNn-VexajL1yS8in_9lr&c=0NW76jQ98XOjVXhFzjpwpH2oBP6qzpny9qAPG758dNY47f342oPwFw==&ch=bf2FWHcds1ir8YI0e5zysZyecxQQe731avKO8ojlv-Bs1_2I-trgsQ==)

(Shoutout to [TrackAIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/27b288cc-c0fd-495b-be20-6e9a9e21d263?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for being the absolute wolverines that we need on this issue. I'm a big fan. They endorsed me in 2024, but for some reason, apparently I haven't popped up on their radar this time around...)

In case you haven't heard yet, Track AIPAC has created a dense, unequivocal policy pledge that any candidate or politician can take. So far, only three Members of Congress have done so: Ro Khanna (CA-17), Rashida Tlaib (MI-12), and Delia Ramirez (IL-3). **As far as I know, I 'm the first Candidate to do so, in any race.**
All the best titles are acronyms... In this case, PEACE stands for:
**P** ledge to
**E** nforce
**A** merican law,
**C** ounter foreign influence, and
**E** nd war crimes.
Love it.

There are 7 clear policy commitments:

**1\. No AIPAC money.** (I never have taken it, and I never will.)

**2\. It is a genocide.** (I've said it from the beginning -- at marches, rallies, and peace vigils alongside my family, including in October 2023. Yes, really. We've been friends of Rachel Corrie's family for 20 years. Aysenur Ezgi Eygi played with my daughter in 2024 -- shortly before she was murdered in the West Bank while peacefully witnessing.)

**3\. I will never vote for US military assistance to any country engaged in war crimes, ethnic cleansing, apartheid, genocide, or restricting humanitarian aid.** Full stop.

**4\. I utterly oppose permanently integrating US military or intelligence functions with any foreign country.** (My father and husband are disabled US military veterans. They swore to defend the United States -- not anyone else. I honor our servicemembers too much to waste their devotion and sacrifice.)

Note, please: The incumbent I'm running to unseat, Adam Smith, is the one who _**co-introduced**_ Section 224, was thanked publicly by AIPAC for it, killed Rep Ro Khanna's amendment in committee, and only flipped under pressure, when he knew it was too later to matter. He made his choice.

**5.** I will work for a**ccountability for those who committed war crimes with American weapons,** and those at home who facilitated them. I support the ICC. I oppose efforts to sanction them.

**6\. I stand wholeheartedly for the First Amendment of the US Constitution** -- including the right to peaceably assemble, speak freely, use economic agency to do so, and criticize foreign governments. Such criticism is not bigotry. It is honesty. It is integrity. And I will protect it.

**7\. I will fight to fix campaign finance,** overturn Citizens United, and get corporate and foreign money out of American politics. (My campaign has always rejected foreign interests, weapons manufacturers, and corporate PACs. My opponent Adam Smith cannot say the same -- he takes AIPAC money and massive donations from war profiteers including Palantir and Anduril, the company that makes AI-powered autonomous weapons.)

I answer to We the People. So should every elected official in America.

In short:
**American wealth for American communities.
American weapons used in integrity with American law.
American politicians answerable to the American people.**

And always, at home and abroad, one North Star:
**Liberty and Justice for ALL.**

Care. Courage. The Constitution.

July 18, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h6nvqzvfzhwqxq9ercnhrm7wg/owhkhqhwmzzp5kfvhr/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvOGt1cWhvaDJyZXo5ZWgzbjY2bW5xZmt6ZHo1NmRpM2hreDlnNQ== )

From Catherine
--------------

Hi Friend —

Thursday night, President Trump stood before the nation from the East Room of the White House and did something no president before him has had the courage to do: he told the American people the truth about the vulnerabilities in our elections. He announced the declassification of intelligence documents pointing to foreign interference, weaknesses in our voting systems, and serious questions about the accuracy of our voter rolls — and, most significantly, he put them online for every citizen to read. He didn't just speak the truth; he built a permanent, transparent channel to keep telling it. Because of that, things will never be the same.

For sixteen years, True the Vote has been sounding these same alarms — often alone, often at great cost. To watch the President of the United States stand up and say them from the White House was a milestone all those years had been building toward.

Since Thursday, our inbox has been full of one question, asked a hundred ways: is True the Vote's work part of this?

The documents detail the Chinese Communist Party's compromise of American voter data on a staggering scale — what the President described as potentially the largest compromise of election data in history — that is the exact threat our investigation into Konnech surfaced years ago, when almost no one wanted to hear it. Notably, that same phrase — the "largest compromise ... in history" — echoes language used by the Assistant District Attorney in Los Angeles County in the Konnech matter (documents linked below) ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h6nvqzvfzhwqxq9ercnhrm7wg/p8heh9h4wvvm8daqh3/aHR0cHM6Ly90cnVldGhldm90ZS5vcmcva29ubmVjaC1jb2xsZWN0aW9u ). But declassified documents are being released in tranches, not all at once. What's public today is a first installment, not the whole file. I expect our specific findings to be reflected as more is declassified in the days and weeks ahead — and when they are, you'll be among the first to know. You can read the China findings released so far for yourself at WhiteHouse.gov/election-integrity ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h6nvqzvfzhwqxq9ercnhrm7wg/x0hph6hevggoxdf5hl/V2hpdGVIb3VzZS5nb3YvZWxlY3Rpb24taW50ZWdyaXR5 ).

As far as the geospatial (cell phone) research that later informed 2000 Mules, that was not included as far as we're aware — but that wasn't a shocker. While the files may ultimately appear among the declassified docs, the FBI proved long ago that they are only interested in cell phone data when it serves their narrative (think J6 protestors being tracked on cell phones, with arrests just days after the event). Wouldn't be at all surprised if those files never surface at all. We'll see.

Our other work around that time — from the yeoman's effort on identifying illegalities in voter rolls, winning the federal lawsuit in Georgia; a series of other bizarre lawsuits involving us (I'll leave it at that for the moment) in which the FBI was tangentially involved, I believe against us; the Grand Jury convened in secret against Gregg Phillips and myself ... my reports to the FBI of having been poisoned ... prison ... it was a lot.

A lot.

I don't know how much of that will ultimately be included. But whatever it is, it is. I bear the memories and the scars. And I'm thankful for all of it, because it has led us to this moment.

I was pensive going into Thursday. In this environment, a single sentence can be lifted out of context and turned into a lifetime of false narratives. But the President managed it masterfully. He set honest expectations, he stayed disciplined, and he opened a new and durable channel for disclosure that will serve this country for years to come. That is leadership, and it deserves our full-throated support.

So here is where I stand. I believe the 2020 election was, in fact, stolen from President Trump. I also understand that the stakes of that statement could not be higher, and that the full weight and force of Chaos will continue to be used to grind down truth tellers. They can surely make things difficult, but they cannot stop truth from finding a way. Therefore, True the Vote will keep doing what we've always done — follow the evidence, show our work, and stand our ground — as the truth comes into the light.

Thank you for standing with us. Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW

Ever onward —

PS — some of you may have caught a sneak peek of the trailer for our new documentary, TRAPPED (Detroit), making the rounds on Instagram. We're holding off on posting it here (or anywhere else) for the moment, and the reason is simple: the shadow banning has already begun. It's hard enough to reach your inbox without landing in Spam, and I won't risk this whole email getting buried by adding a link they're clearly watching for. So consider this your heads-up — it's coming soon. It is real. And I could not be prouder of it. If you can't wait, you'll find it on Pastor Lorenzo Sewell's Instagram at @lorenzosewell. Until then, stand by. We're fortifying our flanks for the battle ahead.

PPS — if you can help us with a donation, ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/75u5p94oe7f8h6nvqzvfzhwqxq9ercnhrm7wg/6qheh8hl8qqz0dbohk/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== ) we will put it to immediate use.

Thank you for your support!

The GA challenges weren’t the only thing in motion. As the Fair Fight case unfolded, informants came forward with reports of ballot trafficking. body:
This morning, I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America."
This morning, I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America."
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e12312490/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YveGpWdFhBUzN0Qw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MTg/LbmNsdlI0U1paTQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNrTkJTRERqRjE3NWxscw/galv8fw/s1gdd0a146f)

---
Dear Patriot,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)When I started undercover investigative journalism as a college student at Rutgers, I pored over the history of journalism. I studied the techniques of great authors who broke stories that transformed America. From Stetson Kennedy, who infiltrated the highest echelons of the KKK in the 1940s, to Upton Sinclair, who went undercover in the 1900s working in a meatpacking plant in Chicago. Sinclair's book, The Jungle, resulted in a national uproar over food safety and the creation of what is now the Food and Drug Administration. Every notable author and journalist who came before me used similar tactics to get the story: fearless boots on the ground. And as I've found in my nearly 20 years as a journalist, my job is limited to what I can see and record through public access . . . undercover or not. At the end of each investigation, I'm left wanting more. I can see the threads dangling in front of me, waiting to be pulled, but accessible only to law enforcement and their powers to investigate. **But today, the world has shifted . . .** This morning, I testified before the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee (HSGAC) of the United States Senate regarding "Fraud in America." Following my opening remarks, where I expressed my limits as a journalist, something extraordinary happened. **Committee Chairman Rand Paul invited me to submit requests for subpoenas to his office.** Notably, Senator Paul, as the chairman of HSGAC, is the only member of the Senate with **unilateral authority** to issue subpoenas. From Upton Sinclair to Woodward and Bernstein, the model for action has been: **Journalist publishes → Institution reacts.** After my testimony before the Senate, that model will be inverted . . . **at least temporarily.** Power shifts. Rules change. **Doors close.** That's why we have to [**move fast**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.), and I need your help more than ever to take advantage of an unprecedented offer. I'm putting together a small team of researchers who can pull those dangling threads left from current and previously closed investigations.
* We can follow the money trails to see who is truly behind the fraudulent ballots.
* We have a shot at unraveling the global web of money that funds illegal immigration.
* We finally have a chance to see the documents behind Pfizer's illegal "Gain of Function" research on COVID-19.

**At the bottom of every rabbit hole is a lock box filled with receipts.** Senator Paul just handed us a golden key. [**Will you help me fund this new squad?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Remember, Al Capone was brought down by an accountant. In today's dollars, Capone's criminal enterprise was worth $2 billion. Taxpayers are being defrauded of at least **$250 billion every year** on the federal level alone — money out of your pocket, counted against your vote. And at the Senate hearing on Fraud in America, our elected officials admitted that the governmental bodies tasked with stopping fraud for decades are wholly ineffective. That leaves us to do the job. Are you in? [**Help me and my team get to work.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) We have HUNDREDS of Al Capones to take down who have been ripping all of us off and stealing our national treasure . . . and our votes. **Time is short.**[**Please help me and my team get started today.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Thank you for all that you do.
In Truth,James O'Keefe Founder, O'Keefe Media Group
P.S. I'm still grasping the impact of the Senate hearing. Most journalists might just smile and say "thank you" if Senator Paul asked them to submit subpoena requests to him. But those journalists have not gone as deep as I have. They haven't risked their lives. Some never leave the comfort of their office. I know what the offer means. I've lived with the frustration of knowing that the true players behind an operation can hide in darkness. With your help, OMG is taking advantage of this immediately — until the door closes. [**Please help fund this rapid response team today.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

This email was sent to **[dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com)** as part of your subscription to **America First War Room**

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

name: Gina
subject: We all share the same Texas pride.
body:
I promise to fight for a Texas we can be proud of again.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**Like a lot of people born and raised in the great state of Texas, I was taught to love and have great pride for our home.**
No matter where we fall on the political spectrum, we all share the same pride.

Barbecue. Whataburger. H-E-B. Friday Night Lights. Bluebonnets. Our neighborhood schools and universities. Beautiful landscapes and natural wonders, from the Gulf Coast to Big Bend. The feeling that Texas is our home.
But since Greg Abbott took office over a decade ago, Texas has fallen behind on the things that matter most to all of us, from education and healthcare to infrastructure.**Right now, Texas ranks low in all of these categories nationally.**
That is unacceptable, and none of this needed to happen.
Texas’s decline is a direct result of the choices Abbott has made, _again and again_ , to put corruption and his billionaire donors ahead of Texans.
Right now, I need to ask a hard question: _**Is this the Texas we want — is it the one we’re proud of?**_
This is not about left or right. **This is about the basics that every Texan deserves. Affordable healthcare.** Strong, well-funded public schools, not Abbott’s voucher scam. Safe roads and reliable infrastructure. Clean water that never runs dry. Communities that are supported, not torn apart.
There is a saying that everything is bigger and better in Texas. But for too many families, it has not felt that way in a really long time.
**As governor, I promise to fight for a Texas we can be proud of. A state that works for working Texans, not billionaires.**
If you believe Texas deserves better, I need you with me.
**[Please pitch in $5 or any amount today to support my campaign for governor and kick Greg Abbott out in November.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260718_3_tx.i1jRcE&refcode=em20260718-1599&amount=5&t=1&akid=1599%2E299639%2EiD3HMI)**

Thank you,
Gina

clean_body: They need our support right now to combat billionaires and corporations buying our elections. | | | Friend, I just stepped off the stage with Bernie Sanders and AOC. Amo Bernie and my sister-in-service Alexandria are here in Michigan rallying for two allies who we need by our side in Congress: Abdul El-Sayed for U.S. Senate and Donavan McKinney for Congress. Both are running people-powered campaigns that reject corporate PAC money. Both are rooted in community, fighting for policies including Medicare for All and a livable wage, demanding economic and environmental justice, and human rights at home and abroad. They need our support right now to combat billionaires and corporations buying our elections, including attacks from AIPAC and its MAGA billionaires. Our opponents are using Islamophobic attacks in an attempt to divide us and pit us against one another. But we know that when we work together, we can combat the billionaire-funded attacks and create a politics that puts our communities ahead of greedy, polluting corporations. I created my Rooted in Community Leadership PAC to elect working-class candidates who understand from experience the needs of the people they represent. We don’t need more millionaires in office or bought-and-paid-for politicians who continue to vote for bombs and genocide while our communities struggle to afford basic needs. body:
Urgent – add your name TODAY

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM4NDI5ODUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjUwMDA5OTcyNgS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | | Trump is obsessed with the anti-voter SAVE America Act, and even sabotaging his own party in the process. He’s refusing to sign other bills until he gets his way — but Democrats in Congress are holding strong against this attack on our freedoms.
---
| | Do you know what that means? **Our pressure is working. Let’s keep it up.**
---
| | [**Tell your Senator: keep elections free and fair — stop the SAVE America Act!**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/9zEZMdz_)

|

---
| |
---

## **Tell Your Senator: **
**Protect Voting Rights, Reject the SAVE America Act!**
Republicans are trying to pass a new version of the anti-voter _SAVE Act_ — their latest attack on our voting rights. This “SAVE America Act” would be the biggest federal rollback of voting rights in our country’s history, particularly burdening 146 million Americans who don’t have a passport, millions who can’t easily access a birth certificate, rural voters, voters of color, voters with disabilities, survivors of climate disasters, and the tens of millions of people — including 69 million married women — who have changed their names. [**_Tell your Senator: keep elections free and fair — stop the SAVE America Act!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Peter,
---
| | Every eligible voter, no matter their race, income, ability, or zip code, has the right to choose their own leaders through free and fair elections. Generations of civil rights activists put their lives on the line to secure these rights, but now Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are trying to rip them away.
---
| | If passed, the SAVE America Act would imperil the fundamental rights of millions of voters across the country, roll back mail voting, cause legitimate voters’ ballots to be thrown out, and make voter registration harder for over 100 million eligible voters. **We can’t let this happen.**
---
| | [**_Tell your Senator: reject the SAVE America Act and protect free and fair elections!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fzX-)
---
| | This bill would hurt communities across the country, including those already suffering from exposure to toxic pollution and other environmental injustices. It would particularly burden 146 million Americans who don’t have a passport, millions who can’t easily access a birth certificate, rural voters, voters of color, voters with disabilities, survivors of climate disasters, and the tens of millions of people — including 69 million married women — who have changed their names.
---
| | Collective grassroots pressure from LCV members like you is essential. Together, we must compel the Senate to reject this attack on our democracy and our ability to choose our own leaders through free and fair elections — so we can all continue advocating for the well-being of people and the planet.
---
| | [**_Add your name today and protect our voting rights!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XBd-x~)
---
| | Thank you for your commitment to supporting free and fair elections, and to the safe, just, and equitable future we all deserve.
---
| | Sincerely,

subject: Guess who just voted against cutting military aid to Israel
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

On Wednesday — for the first time EVER — the majority of Democrats in
Congress voted to cut $3.3 billion in unconditional military funding to
Israel.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260718-2.MdYx8G&refcode=em20260718-38051&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38051%2E1203867%2EPzk7RT ]A post on X from @ryangrim: '🚨House Democrats just voted 103-98, with
10 voting 'present,' to eliminate all aid to Israel. Proposing this a few
years ago would practically have gotten you censured. Cutting off all aid
to Israel is now the majority position inside the House Democratic caucus.
Nearly every Republican voted with Israel, making the final vote 314 - 104
in favor of Israel (with 10 present).'

Even a year ago, this would have been unthinkable — but the tide is
turning.

The overwhelming majority of Democratic voters have made it clear through
polling, activism, and this year’s primary elections that they’re tired of
politicians using our tax dollars to enable genocide and war crimes.

Make no mistake: this outcome is a direct result of our progressive
movement and the power of the primary.

In the last month, we unseated two different pro-Israel incumbents,
sending a warning to every other Democrat in Congress.

But 98 cowardly Democrats still voted against this amendment, including
our next two primary opponents: Wesley Bell in MO-01 and Shri Thanedar in
MI-13.

Bell and Thanedar have both been backed by AIPAC and their network of
right-wing megadonor-funded super PACs. They are choosing to ignore their
constituents and keep prioritizing the wishes of the pro-Israel lobby and
the military-industrial complex.

These AIPAC stooges would rather spend billions of our hard-earned
taxpayer dollars dropping bombs on families overseas than help our working
families here at home in St. Louis and Detroit.

And we have the chance to kick them both out of office on August 4th.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260718-2.MdYx8G&refcode=em20260718-38051&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=38051%2E1203867%2EPzk7RT ]Let’s replace Bell and Thanedar with progressive champions Cori Bush
and Donavan McKinney in less than 3 weeks: rush a grassroots donation of
$5 now!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260718-2.MdYx8G&refcode=em20260718-38051&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=38051%2E1203867%2EPzk7RT ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: Three reasons for today, July 18
body:
Unlike my opponent, I’m running a grassroots campaign, so I mean it when I say that the best way I can fight back and stay on track to flip this seat is if folks like you chip in.

# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=2246%2E124072%2EEqkuTd)

---
| | Peter, things aren't looking as good as they were. **I need your help.** I’m going to give you three reasons why chipping in $5 to my campaign today could really lend me a hand.
---
| | 1\. JD Vance came to North Carolina to spread lies about me, President Trump has taken to Truth Social multiple times to personally attack me and Stephen Miller just went on Fox News to rant and rave about me.
---
| | 2\. Republican dark-money super PACs have committed over $100 million so far to this race to defeat me and try to buy this seat for my MAGA opponent.
---
| | 3\. Now, all of the GOP's attacks are working: **A new poll shows this race tightening. My slight lead has been cut nearly _in half_.**
---
| | Quite simply, Peter, we’re getting outspent by the GOP by a margin of 5:1 – and we’re seeing the damage it’s doing.
---
| | **Unlike my opponent, I’m running a grassroots campaign, so I mean it when I say that the best way I can fight back and stay on track to flip this seat is if folks like you chip in. $5 here, a few bucks there. Every dollar counts and means a lot to me.**
